Gem Imports FAQs | Pound Shop Supplier
Below is a list of our most frequently asked questions. Here you can find information on ordering, delivery information and more.
If you don’t find the answer you’re looking for, you can contact us through the Contact Us section of our website.
Delivery - FAQ
Find out the answers to our most frequently asked delivery questions...
If you can’t find the answer to your query, contact customer service on 01226 395095 (Mon-Fri 8:30 am to 5 pm)
Q. What are your shipping costs?
A. Our delivery charges are based on pallet rates by our carrier, which are visible on the checkout page and on our delivery information page:
• UK Mainland - we offer free delivery on orders over £500 net.
• Scottish Highlands & Islands - shipping is calculated on the basket page.
• For Channel Islands orders - shipping is calculated on the basket page.
• Northern & Southern Ireland - we offer free delivery on orders over £2,000 net. For orders between £1,000 and £2,000, shipping is calculated on the basket page.
• Europe - rates for European deliveries are dependent on the size and weight of your order. Please contact us to obtain a quote before placing your order by calling 01226 395095 or by emailing customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk.
Q. How long before I receive my order?
A. Orders placed before 10 pm, Monday to Friday, will be dispatched within two working days. Orders placed on a weekend will be dispatched the following Tuesday.
Please note that some delays may occur during Bank Holidays.
• On the day that we dispatch your order, we will email you with your invoice. Your order will arrive within the following timescales:
• Mainland UK within 3-5 working days
• Scottish Highlands, Northern Ireland, Channel Islands and Offshore Islands within 3-5 working days
• Europe within 10 - 14 working days
• Under exceptional circumstances, we can allow for a named day delivery; however, this incurs a surcharge.
Delivery times are not binding
Q. What are your normal delivery slots?
A. Our courier usually delivers between 8 am and 6 pm, Monday to Friday. On rare occasions, some couriers may deliver outside of this time frame. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept requests for specific times or days.
All orders are dispatched on pallets, which are shrink-wrapped and fully covered. Whilst every effort is made to deliver orders in immaculate condition, occasionally damage can occur in transit. If you notice any visible signs of damage to the exterior pallets or cartons, please contact customer service on 01226 395095 or email customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk. Please do not accept the delivery if you suspect significant damage has been caused.
All goods are delivered on trucks equipped with rear tail lifts; therefore, please ensure your desired delivery address has sufficient access for the driver to safely and legally stop to unload the delivery. The driver is not responsible for decanting pallets; therefore, you will need to use your own personal equipment where possible to accept and take goods into your premises. Deliveries must be signed for by an adult aged 18 or over.
Please ensure that all details, including your delivery address, are correct, as we cannot be held accountable for any delivery errors caused by incorrect information you have provided.
Q. Do you charge VAT on European orders?
A. We will not charge VAT on European orders if we are shipping your order directly to you in an EU country. You must also provide us with a valid EU VAT-registered number. If we are shipping your order to a UK freight forwarder of your choice, or you have arranged for your order to be collected from our premises, we will charge VAT accordingly. Once your order has been shipped from the UK and you provide us with a valid export document that includes an EU VAT-registered number, we will refund the VAT we charged you.
Q. Can I ask for a Saturday or named day delivery?
A. Your order can be upgraded to be delivered on a named day or on a Saturday; however, this will incur a delivery surcharge.
Q. Do you ship internationally (outside the EU)?
A. We can deliver your order to any UK freight forwarder, who will ship your order to any worldwide destination. However, you would need to arrange your own freight forwarder and pay their costs. You will also be required to complete all necessary export documentation.
Opening an account FAQ's
Do you have queries about opening an account with Gem Imports?
See our most frequently asked questions below... Call 01226 395095 or register for a FREE account here.
Q. Do I have to be a company owner or run a business to buy from you?
A. No, anyone can buy from our product range, but we do have a minimum order value of £500 excluding VAT.
Q. Do you have a minimum order?
A. Yes, we do. The minimum order on www.gemimports.co.uk is £500 net (before VAT or delivery charges). You can order as many different products as you want, but each product is sold by the carton, not individually.
Q. Can I place an order for less than your minimum order?
A. Unfortunately, not. Our warehouse and logistics systems are designed to process large orders; therefore, all orders are shipped on pallets rather than in individual cartons.
Q. Some of your products have assorted colours, can I choose the colour of products that I buy?
A. No. If a product has assorted colours, styles or designs, you would purchase a mixed carton. We cannot split cartons.
Q. How do I make payment?
A. We accept all credit and debit cards, and there are no additional fees when paying by credit card. You can also use PayPal or a bank transfer (BACS). If paying by BACS, we can only dispatch your order once the funds have cleared in our account. This usually takes 5-7 working days. Please note that we require bank transfer payments to be made within 48 hours of receipt of a pro-forma invoice. Any delay in making your payment may result in the cancellation of your order, and we may charge an administration fee.
Q. Do you offer credit accounts?
A. At any time, you can complete a Gem Imports Credit Application Form. This can be downloaded from your 'My Account Section' of the website. A member of our sales team will review this, and you will be notified of the outcome. Please be aware that to process your application, we will perform a soft credit check.
Q. Do you have discount codes or special offers?
A. We are the UK's cheapest online wholesaler, and we work hard to offer you the lowest possible price. All wholesale prices on our website are already discounted.
Ordering Process FAQ'S
Ordering with Gem Imports is simple,
1. Register for a FREE account Here
2. View and browse our unrivalled wholesale prices.
3. Checkout and receive your delivery within 3-5 working days.
Still need some questions answered? See our most frequently asked questions below.
Q. How does Pre-Order work?
For certain departments and product ranges, we have introduced the ability to secure your stock in advance of delivery into our warehouse.
We understand that many of you want to ensure access to products that are not yet in our warehouse, and this is the way to do it.
Whilst you've always been able to do this through our sales team, you can now do it yourself on this website.
How does it work?
You can Pre-order products that have the ‘Pre-Order’ badge displayed on them, which looks like this..
Pre-order products can only be ordered along with products from the same range. For example, if you want to order your standard replenishment stock for immediate delivery and pre-order from our Christmas range, you will need to place two separate orders. Both orders must meet a net order value of £500.
You cannot mix pre-ordered products with products from other ranges. The £500 minimum order value applies to pre-orders as usual.
Why do I have to order pre-order products separately?
To keep things simple and avoid mixing in-stock items with pre-orders, we ask that pre-order products be purchased only with other items from the same range. This helps us manage orders smoothly and keep prices competitive for you.
What is Pre-order Pay Later?
We understand that although you might want to secure your stock a long time in advance of the season, you might not always want to pay for it at the time of ordering.
For selected Pre-Order ranges, we offer "Pre-order Pay Later" - place your Pre-Order now, and we'll only ask for payment closer to the shipping date.
How do I create a Pre-order?
Navigate to the range of products you are interested in Pre-ordering, and look for the Pre-order badge. You can add as many Pre-order products as you wish to your basket, but they must:
All be from the same product range (e.g. all Halloween).
Have a total basket value of £500 minimum (i.e. our minimum order value of £500 applies to pre-orders too)
Once you have finalised your basket, go to checkout and 1. Either pay as usual, or 2. select "PAY ON ACCOUNT" - Selecting this will secure your order without any payment needed until closer to the season.
Your order will be sent once all items are in stock.
I need help with Pre-ordering.
Please contact our Customer Service team, and we'll be happy to help.
Q. Can I add additional products once I have checked out?
A. For us to offer a fast and professional service, once an order has been placed, it is immediately picked up by our warehouse. Any request to add products that we can meet may delay processing your order and may incur an administration charge. Please call us on 01226 395095 or email customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk quoting your name and order number to discuss this request.
Q. I have changed my mind, can I cancel my order?
A. Once we receive an order, it is processed immediately by our warehouse team. We regret that we can only cancel or amend orders under extreme circumstances. Please call us on 01226 395095 or email customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk quoting your name and order number to request this cancellation. We will do our very best to accommodate your request. If your order has been picked, your request may incur a cancellation charge. Unfortunately, we cannot cancel your order if it has already been shipped.
Q. There is a few pence difference between my invoice and my original order?
A. This is a standard industry occurrence and should not cause any problems when you are processing your company accounts and VAT returns. The difference is due to an anomaly in accounting systems where decimal places are rounded up when calculating VAT. Our website calculates VAT at the carton level rather than an accounting system that rounds VAT up from individual units.
Q. If I buy in bulk, can I receive a further discount?
A. We import all of our products in large quantities so that we can offer them at a discount price. If you want to purchase products in vast quantities, you may be eligible to use our direct import service, whereby we import your products directly from the Far East. The minimum order is a 20ft container. Please contact our customer service team by calling 01226 395095 or emailing customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk to discuss.
Q. Do you have any sales reps?
A. Yes, call 01226 395095 or email customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk to arrange a visit from one of our sales managers. We also have a showroom in South Yorkshire where you can view our products and receive advice.
Q. Can I use your website content on my own website?
A. You are permitted to save our product photography from our website by simply right-clicking on the image and selecting 'Save image as'. However, you cannot use our product descriptions. This is because search engines penalise websites that use the same content. Using our product descriptions will damage your search engine optimisation.
Q. Do you have a drop shipping service?
A. We do not ship units directly to end customers. We can deliver to any address in the UK, but you must meet our minimum order delivery requirement of £500 net.
If none of the above has answered your question, please do not hesitate to contact us by completing our Online Form, emailing customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk, or calling us on 01226 395090. A member of our team will respond as soon as possible.  Thank you.

Gem Imports Ltd is proud to deliver a wide choice of consumer brands to suit your individual needs.
Our brands will comfortably sit in store, alongside other major retail brands and offer the same quality and reputation that customers have grown to expect from their individual choice of household names. Each of our brands has its own identity, personality and product range, but each one shares the same basic principle of representing quality and value to the customer, while meeting relevant manufacturing standards and safety certifications. product.name: Lenor Unstoppables In Wash Scent Boosters Spring Awakening
product.ingredients: Perfumes, Camphor, Coumarin, Dimethyl Phenethyl Acetate, Eucalyptus Globulus Oil, Geraniol, Hexyl cinnamal, Lavandula Oil/ Extract, Limonene, Linalool, Linalyl Acetate, Pogostemon Cablin Oil, Rose Ketones, Terpineol, Terpinolene, Tetramethyl Acetyloctahydronaphthalenes, Vanillin.
product.features: A boost of non-stop freshness for your laundry up to 12 weeks in storage, In-Wash scent booster with a clean fragrance composed of inspired by accords of herbal green scents and sea water like accords water of the sea, floral notes of Lily of the valley and effervescent citrus, Personalise the scent intensity by choosing the quantity of scent boosters you want to use, Can be added to every loads, with all types of fabrics, Pour the in-wash scent booster beads directly into the empty drum before your laundry
product.detailed_description: Discover Lenor laundry perfume in-wash scent booster for a boost of non stop freshness up to 12 weeks in storage, Lenor infuses your clothes with a scent of spring flowers. A clean fragrance inspired by the accords of the fresh florals and warm mossy amber. Lenor Spring Awakening In-Wash Scent Boosters were created to work in perfect harmony with Lenor Spring Awakening Softener.
product.other_information: Safety Warning: Keep out of reach of children. IF SWALLOWED: Immediately call a doctor. Contains Coumarin, Methyl Dihydroxy-dimethylbenzoate, Hexyl cinnamal, Delta-Damascone, 4-tert-Butylcyclohexyl Acetate, 2,4-Dimethyl-3-Cyclohexene Carboxaldehyde. May produce an allergic reaction.
product.preparation_and_usage: Recommended dose = 12.2 g. Keep away from sunlight and heating more than 30°C.

Home
About Us
All About Deva
Deva Designs is a leading supplier of design led gift wrapping in the UK, the Republic of Ireland and currently exports to major world markets.
Twice a year, we launch a totally new range of designs - this includes over 70 gift wraps, 15 gift bag designs, 15 roll wraps and colour coordinated gift wrapping accessories. The range is diverse to ensure that there is always something to meet our customer's different needs.
At Deva Designs, we constantly innovate with new materials and finishes to ensure we continue to set the trends that others follow.
No one can fail to appreciate the draw of a leading designer and the consumer power of their brands - Deva Designs is delighted to work with leading designers such as Designers Guild, Katie Phythian and Stop The Clock and we are continuing to add new artists such as Jessica Hogarth and Sarah Kelleher to keep the range fresh and contemporary.
Positioned clearly on the premium end of the gift wrap market, we know that customer satisfaction comes from exceeding expectations and we pride ourselves on the quality of our products and our service to customers.

product.name: Pasta Di Aldo Filini Egg Pasta Air Dried
product.ingredients: Durum Wheat Semolina, Eggs (32%)
product.allergens: Contains Eggs, Contains Wheat
product.features: Cooks in 5 minutes, Artisan product, Egg pasta, Slowly air-dried the traditional method
product.detailed_description: 'Pasta Di Aldo' is named after the first two letters of each surname of Luigi Donnari and his wife Maria Alzapiedi, who make just 50kg of dried pasta per day from their tiny workshop in Monte San Giusto the Le Marche region of Italy. Using a variety of local wheats for each product, the pasta is hand-kneaded then rolled out on a small machine, cut by hand and then hung to dry slowly in low temperatures for a natural drying process. The final step is packing into fine handmade boxes. The resulting pasta has a rough texture and a bright egg colour, which on eating is light and fragrant. Widely regarded by Italians as one of the best artisan pastas in Italy, it is also endorsed by Heston Blumenthal who has described it in his book 'In Search Of Perfection' as "perhaps the finest pasta in Italy"

Our latest planet-friendly products
20th September 2019Rachel.McCarty
Share: [image: Facebook] [image: Share]
Get inspired to go green with eco-friendly alternatives to your everyday items. Check out the latest products and newest designs in our range of reusable and recycled products.
String bags
Our brand new collection of string bags is made from 100% organic cotton! They are certified by the Global Organic Textile Standard, which means that these bags meet certain environmental, toxicological and social criteria (you can find out more about this on their website).
String bags are colourful, completely plastic-free, and expand easily to fit in plenty of shopping. Take a look at some of the bold colours available:
[image: rex-london-bright-string-bags]
Organic cotton string bags, £5.95 each
If you prefer more pastel hues, we’ve got those too:
[image: rex-london-pastel-string-bags]
Organic cotton string bags, £5.95 each
Steel bottles
Stainless steel bottles have proven themselves to be a hugely popular alternative to single-use plastic bottles. Not only do they keep your drinks cool for up to 24 hours, and warm for up 12 hours, but they look great too, coming in a range of fun and hard-wearing designs.
Many coffee shops and cafes now offer free water in a bid to reduce disposable water bottles, so be sure you always keep your bottle on you.
[image: best-in-show-steel-bottle]
Best in Show stainless steel bottle, £19.95
Bags made from recycled plastics
Whatever size bag you need, we’ve got you covered, from our portable Charlotte bags, up to our iconic jumbo storage bags. Best of all, each one of these handy bags is made with recycled plastic materials.
Lunch bags
Our classic lunch bags do the planet good and look even better. Available in more than 30 designs, they’re foil-lined to help keep packed lunches fresh whether at school, at work, or on a day out.
[image: love-birds-lunch-bag-lifestyle]
Love Birds lunch bag, £3.95
Shopping bags
We all know that a reusable shopping bag is now a handbag and household essential, but there’s no reason for them to be dull and ordinary. We’ve got more than 20 wonderful designs, including our chilled-out Sydney the Sloth, below.
[image: sydney-sloth-shopper-bag-lifestyle.jpg]
Sydney the Sloth shopping bag, £2.95
Did you know? The recycled materials that make up our shopping bags are equivalent to six plastic bottles!
Jumbo storage bags
Our jumbo bags are renowned for their versatility, strength, and, of course, striking good looks. Made from recycled plastics, these storage superstars come in more than 30 designs, including our adorable new feline friend, Chester the Cat.
[image: chester-the-cat-jumbo-bag]
Chester the Cat jumbo storage bag, £4.95
And yes, there’s even a Christmas one in our latest festive design, Nordic Christmas, so early-bird shoppers can start hiding those presents from prying eyes. It’s also perfect for storing all your Christmas decorations safely and neatly throughout the rest of the year.
[image: nordic-christmas-jumbo-bag]
Nordic Christmas jumbo storage bag, £4.95
Bamboo tableware
Our range of products made with bamboo fibre continues to grow, including a large collection of stylish travel mugs. We’re delighted that our bold Space Age bamboo tableware set has recently been shortlisted for the Junior Design Awards 2019.
[image: space-age-bamboo-tableware]
Space Age bamboo tableware set, £15.95
They have also caught the eye of the team at the Progressive Preschool Awards, with our Prehistoric Land bamboo tableware set being listed as a 2019 finalist, along with our sweet bamboo egg plate.
[image: prehistoric-land-egg-plate-preschool-final-listed-2019]
Prehistoric Land bamboo egg plate, £6.95
Behind the scenes
Environmental responsibility continues to be a priority for us, so as well as offering more eco-friendly products and gifts, we’re also working to reduce the amount of plastic used in our packaging processes. This includes the recent introduction of paper parcel tape, shown below.
[image: rex-london-paper-packing-tape]
Rex London paper packaging tape, replacing the previous plastic tape.
You can find out more about our plans by reading our green initiative.
We’d love to see your posts of you using your eco-friendly products. Be sure to tag them with #RexLondon so we can see!

Orders
Are all items shown on your website available?
All items shown on our website are in stock and will be dispatched directly from our warehouse. On very rare occasions, we may not be able to supply an item. If this happens, we will inform you as soon as possible by phone or email that the goods you have ordered are unavailable and automatically refund you.
What payment methods do you accept?
For UK based customers, we accept all major debit/credit cards and PayPal.
For EU based customers, we accept Visa, Mastercard, Maestro and Bancontact.
Can I amend my order after I have placed it?
Unfortunately, due to the nature of our packing process, orders cannot be changed once they are placed.
If you would like to add/remove items, or change the delivery address, you will need to cancel the order and start again. To cancel a pending order, please email us at [email protected]. We should be able to cancel the order if it has not been packed yet.
How can I track the status of my order?
Once your order is dispatched, you will receive an email with a tracking link for the courier delivering your order.
If you have a Rex London account, order status and tracking information can be found by logging in and going to the Orders tab of the My account page.
I need to cancel my order. What should I do?
Please email us at [email protected] as soon as possible.
If your order has not been packed yet, we should be able to cancel it for you.
If your order has been packed, unfortunately we will be unable to cancel it for you. However, once you have received delivery of your order, you have up to 30 days to return it for a refund.
I have received my order, but no longer want it. Can I return it?
You have up to 30 days from receipt of your order to change your mind and request a refund. Please contact us to arrange the return of your order. You are responsible for the cost of returning any unwanted item(s) and you must return your items within 14 days of confirmed return. Your statutory rights are not affected.
Please note: in accordance with UK law, if your full order has been returned to us, we will refund the cost of the goods plus the initial postage and packing charges. Initial postage and packing charges will not be refunded unless all items are returned.
I have received my order, but an item was missing/damaged. What should I do?
To ensure 100% accuracy of your order, we scan and record products after picking and again while packing. However, if on receipt of your order you do find an item missing or damaged, please contact us.
Delivery
Do you deliver to my address?
We deliver to most addresses in the UK. Please go to our UK delivery page to find out more about where we deliver to.
How much does delivery cost?
We have a few options depending on what service you would like. Please go to our UK delivery page to find out information about the delivery options we offer and how much these cost.
How long will delivery take?
Please go to our UK delivery page to find out information about the estimated delivery times for the delivery options we offer.
Which courier will deliver my order?
We currently use the following couriers to deliver orders:
Royal Mail
Parcelforce
Please go to our UK delivery page to find out more.
How do I find out where my order is?
Once your order is dispatched, you will receive an email with a tracking link for the courier delivering your order (Royal Mail or Parcelforce).
If you have a Rex London account, order status and tracking information can be found by logging in and going to the Orders tab of the My account page.
What should I do if my order hasn't arrived on time?
If your order has not been delivered within the estimated delivery time, please contact us.
Rex London (Rex International Ltd.) cannot be held liable for any loss or damage, or consequential loss or damage related to not getting a delivery in time. If you have chosen the Expedited UK delivery option, we will gladly refund the expedited delivery element of the delivery charge.
What should I do if the courier is unable to deliver my order?
If the courier is unable to deliver your order (you missed your delivery or the courier had an issue), please see the support page for the relevant courier listed below to find out what to do:
Royal Mail
Parcelforce

Please see our Returns page for full details on how to return an item you no longer want.
How do I return a damaged, faulty or incorrect item?
Please see our Returns page for full details on how to return a damaged, faulty or incorrect item.
Contacting Customer Services
How do I contact Customer Services?
You can contact our Customer Services team via the following:
Email: [email protected]
Telephone: UK +44 (0)20 8746 2473
Contact Us form: our contact form can be found here.
Please note that our customer service team is available Monday - Friday from 7am-2pm. Thank you for your patience when contacting us outside these hours.
Recycling
What is your policy on recycling electronic equipment?
The Waste Electrical and Electronic Equipment (WEEE) Directive requires UK distributors to maximise separate collection and environmentally friendly processing of WEEE. UK distributors (including retailers) are required to provide a system which allows all customers buying new electrical equipment the opportunity to recycle their old items free of charge.
As a responsible retailer, we are pleased to offer you the chance to recycle your old electrical items. In accordance with the WEEE regulations, you can return electrical goods (you will need to cover any postage and packaging costs) to the address below:
Rex International Ltd.
Unit 3 - 4 Allied Way
London
W3 0RL
United Kingdom
To remind you that old electrical equipment can be recycled, it is now marked with a crossed-out wheeled bin symbol. Please do not throw any electrical equipment (including those marked with the crossed out wheeled bin symbol) in your bin.
Find more information on WEEE recycling, and locate your local recycling centre, at www.recyclenow.com.
Your data
Are my details safe?
Keeping information about you secure is very important to us:
We encrypt data using SSL/TLS (Secure Sockets Layer/Transport Layer Security) encryption, the most secure form of encryption currently available.
We never store payment card details.
Data protection
Rex International Ltd. is registered with the Information Commissioner's Office (ICO) in the UK as a “data controller” in accordance with the provisions of the Data Protection Act 1998. Our registration number is Z119375X. Further details of our registration and information about your personal data rights can be found at ico.org.uk.
Please see our Privacy Policy page for full details on how we store and use your data.
Cookies
We use cookies to personalise content and ads, to provide social media features and to analyse our traffic. We also share information about your use of our site with our social media, advertising and analytics partners who may combine it with other information that you’ve provided to them or that they’ve collected from your use of their services.
You have full control over these cookies. We use Cookiebot software to enable you to fully manage your cookie preferences. When visiting our website, you have the choice to accept all cookies, reject all cookies or customise cookie settings.
Please see our Privacy Policy page for further details on the use of cookies on our website.

Incontinence pads and liners
01
How can I tell the front from the back for Always Discreet Liners and Pads?
For Always Discreet
Liners
and
Pads,
it does not matter which direction you place the product in your underwear.
How are Always Discreet Liners and Pads different from menstrual products?
Similar to many menstrual liners and pads, Always Discreet Liners and Pads contain Absorbent Gel Material (AGM).  The AGM in Always Discreet Liners and Pads, however, was developed primarily for urine, as urine is a much less viscous (thinner) fluid than menstrual fluid. This type of AGM has also been used in some of our baby nappies to enable fluid distribution throughout the core and store it away from the surface.
Why is there elastic/cuffs/barriers on Always Discreet Pads and Pads+?
The cuffs/barriers on
Always Discreet Pads+
and
Pads
are designed to help stop leaks in the leg area, because that is where most leaks occur.
Why isn’t there an elastic/cuff/barrier on Liners?
Always Discreet Liners do not have this feature because they are designed for smaller leaks and are not as necessary in this product.
Does Always Discreet have a Liner or Pad with wings?
No, Always Discreet does not have a liner or pad with wings.
How often should Always Discreet Pads and Liners be changed?
You should change your Always Discreet
Liners
and
Pads
based on your personal needs.
How long should Always Discreet Liners and Pads be worn?
We recommend that you wear Always Discreet Liners and Pads for whatever duration is appropriate for your personal needs.
There is a wide variety of
Always Discreet incontinence products for bladder weakness
to meet the needs of all women. These draw away moisture and neutralise odour.

SUSTAINABILITY.
SUSTAINABILITY.
Sustainability is not something that we do; it is what we are. It's in our nature. Caring for people, for the planet is something that we do every day, since the very beginning of our company. And every day we want to do better, for ourselves, for others and therefore for future generations. Our goal is to be 100% circular by 2035.
Manifest
WE ARE BRABANTIA.
In a world of overconsumption and an abundance of low-cost, low-quality products, Brabantia wants to show there is a better way. Not just with thoughtfully designed, iconic products, that are built to last, but also by making you think about your daily routines, like separating waste, storing food to prevent waste, and drying your laundry naturally.
PURPOSE STATEMENT.
Call it a purpose, a mission or even a compulsion. Whatever words you choose, it’s a real thing. Caring for others and the environment, caring for the earth that nurtures us, the air we breathe and the water that helps us flourish. We’re not perfect, but we’re all responsible and we all have a part to play. Some small, some big. It’s in everything we do and always has been. We create products where beauty meets sustainability. And right now, it’s more important than ever.
Why? Because there’s no longer a choice between profit or people and planet. We’re entering a period in time where all of us have the chance to make a difference. With every action we take, with every decision we make. That’s why we’re choosing to leave the next generation a legacy, not a mess. We’re making the move to 100% circular design by 2035, a reduced CO2 footprint and long-term wellbeing of all our stakeholders.
What legacy do you want to leave?
Read our 2025 impact report
Brabantia has been a Certified B Corporation™ since March 2023. B Corps™ are companies verified against standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability. This certification aligns with our ambition to achieve 100% circular design by 2035 and supports our commitment to continuously improve the way we do business for people and the planet.
For decades, Brabantia has been helping people separate waste, keep food fresh for longer and dry laundry naturally. Now, we want to do even better: 100% circular design by 2035. And that means 100% material health, 100% clean wastewater, 100% renewable energy, 100% recycled production waste, 100% recycled/biobased materials and 100% recyclable products. We’re really going for it!
OUR SIX PILLARS TO 100% CIRCULAR DESIGN:
We want the materials we use during production, processing and use to be as safe as possible for people and the environment – safer than legally required, even. According to legislation, we already reached 100% safe materials. However, based on our own stricter standards, we achieved 99% in 2025 too.
We strive to minimise our energy use and want to ensure that all energy we do use comes from 100% renewable sources by 2035. In 2025, a change in our energy mix resulted in a small step forward.
We want our wastewater to be so clean that it can be processed into drinking water.
We improved waste collection in production and warehousing, our recycling rate slightly decreased to 91%.
This remains one of our most challenging ambitions – but we're making steady progress. In 2025, we increased to 53%, thanks to broader use of recycled plastic in our products like the Sort and Go Recycle Bins.
Our path to 100% recyclable products continues – though it's not always linear. A change in the product mix has resulted in an overall rate of 82%.
MORE CRADLE TO CRADLE® CERTIFICATION.
Our aim is to do better every year. Like raising the number of products that are Cradle to
Cradle® certified at silver level. In 2024, more products received Cradle-to-Cradle Silver
certification, bringing the share of in-house produced items with C2C certification to
83%. Today, Brabantia offers at least 700 Cradle-to-Cradle certified products, including
206 at Silver level—a result that reflects our commitment to meaningful, circular design.
ABOUT CRADLE TO CRADLE®
Cradle to Cradle® means that it is possible to reuse every raw material and material used for a product endlessly – without losing value. You can recognise products by the special Cradle to Cradle® certification. Products are assessed on five components: Safe materials, Reuse of materials, Clean air and climate protection, Water and soil management and Social responsibility. The main goal of Cradle to Cradle® design is a constant cycle of raw materials and thus the prevention of waste. There are five levels of certification.
The certificates are reviewed every two years. In order to maintain the high C2C score, we have to keep making our products more sustainable. It forces us to continue to keep pushing for more sustainability and circularity in our products
MATERIAL HEALTH.
Ensuring materials are safe for humans and the environment.
WATER & SOIL STEWARDSHIP.
Safeguarding clean water and healthy soils.
SOCIAL FAIRNESS.
Respecting human rights and contributing to a fair and equitable society.
CLEAN AIR & CLIMATE PROTECTION.
Protecting clean air, promoting renewable energy, and reducing harmful emissions.
PRODUCT CIRCULARITY.
Enabling a circular economy through regenerative products and process design.

LOVE TO RECYCLE.
The Sort & Go Recycle Bins are all you need to set up your own system for storing and sorting different types of waste. The small ones are ideal for disposal of organic waste, right on the kitchen counter. The bigger ones are great for bottles, cans, packaging or anything else you want sorted. And the best thing - soon made from 100% post-consumer recycled plastic!
BIG BA(N)G.
You want your bin liners to be strong and sustainable. In 2025, we have taken a next big step by moving from 35% to 100% recycled plastic* bin liners, whilst keeping the bags strong and perfect fit. From waste for waste!
*Excluding colourants and additives
100% RECYCLED, 100% RECYCLABLE.
Brabantia already scores 33% on use of recycled material in 2021 - 94% of the material of our products can be recycled after use to make new products.
A beautiful example: The NewIcon Pedal Bin 30 litres in Matt Steel is made of 68% recycled material (37% household waste and 31% industrial waste). Already 99.9% of this model can be reused.
100% RECYCLED, 100% RECYCLABLE.
Brabantia already scores 33% on use of recycled material in 2021 - 94% of the material of our products can be recycled after use to make new products.
A beautiful example: The NewIcon Pedal Bin 30 litres in Matt Steel is made of 68% recycled material (37% household waste and 31% industrial waste). Already 99.9% of this model can be reused.
STEPUP. THE NEXT STEP IN RECYCLING.
STEPUP. THE NEXT STEP IN RECYCLING.
The new StepUp Pedal Bins are made from and for recycled waste. First, they have a click-on label holder and free labels to set up your own personal recycling system. They’re affordable and space-saving too, so you can easily put two or three of them together. And after use, they are 99% recyclable. And their production is also pretty green: they are made from 91% household waste. No wonder these bins are Cradle to Cradle® Certified at silver level.
A BRIGHT FUTURE.
The StepUp collection is made to last. In addition, we offer a 10-year warranty. If something is broken, we will provide a replacement part or a replacement product. This way, the StepUp lasts even longer. A bin for the future.
More StepUp Pedal Bins
Made with 100% Fairtrade Cotton.
As of 2025, all Brabantia ironing board covers are now made with 100% Fairtrade cotton. This means that all of the cotton is Fairtrade certified, traded, audited and sourced from Fairtrade producers. The strict Fairtrade standards are designed to ensure farmers and workers are all safe, have good working conditions and are treated fairly – especially those in Asia, Africa and Latin-America. As well as protecting the environment  where Fairtrade cotton is grown. Choosing Fairtrade cotton for our ironing board covers is yet another step towards a fairer, more sustainable, and ethical world
View our ironing board covers made with Fairtrade cotton
A sustainable home: B.HOME.
In 2021, the construction of our new, sustainable head office ‘B.Home’ on the Leenderweg in Valkenswaard started. It’s on historic ground, as this is where our factory used to be. During the construction of the new building, the foundation of the old factory was reused. And that is just one example of the circularity and sustainability of our new home. There are many more, because the office is designed according to BREEAM principles. For example, the skeleton of the building is entirely made of wood and can easily be disassembled and reused.
On the roof, you will find sedum and a whopping 222 solar panels. Around the building we will we our own garden and we collect rainwater as much as possible. Some of the wall covering inside is made of recycled old army uniforms. The lamps are made from old CDs, the chairs from recycled PET bottles and the walls are painted with Fairf. This paint is made from plant material and therefore contributes to lowering the CO2 level. So B.Home is not just an office, but living proof of our desire to live and work sustainably.
BRABANTIA AND WEFOREST.
Brabantia has been working with WeForest since 2014. Since then, more than 3 million trees have been planted in the Amhara and Desa’a regions of Ethiopia and Burkina Faso.
The trees keep the fertile soil in place by sheltering the soil during heavy rainfall, they provide employment and will feed people, because WeForest also plants fruit and wood trees on farms

MORE SUSTAINABLE TOGETHER.
Together, we can make the world a more beautiful place. We’re happy to help with household tasks and support a more sustainable lifestyle. From separating
waste and preventing food waste to natural drying and reducing laundry loads: our products make everyday chores more enjoyable and more sustainable! How
beautiful is that?
Drying naturally.
Drying laundry on a rotary dryer or drying rack helps you save electricity - and keeps your clothes looking good for longer. And did you know the wind helps reduce creases too? That means less ironing when you dry naturally!
Rotary dryers
Separating waste in style.
Separating waste? Do it in style with our smart products. From handy waste bins with 1, 2 or 3 inner compartments to countertop trays and
stackable waste bins to set up your own recycling station with: we offer an extensive range to make separating waste more beautiful, pleasurable, and sustainable.

SUSTAINABILITY.
SUSTAINABILITY.
Sustainability is not something that we do; it is what we are. It's in our nature. Caring for people, for the planet is something that we do every day, since the very beginning of our company. And every day we want to do better, for ourselves, for others and therefore for future generations. Our goal is to be 100% circular by 2035.
Manifest
WE ARE BRABANTIA.
In a world of overconsumption and an abundance of low-cost, low-quality products, Brabantia wants to show there is a better way. Not just with thoughtfully designed, iconic products, that are built to last, but also by making you think about your daily routines, like separating waste, storing food to prevent waste, and drying your laundry naturally.
PURPOSE STATEMENT.
Call it a purpose, a mission or even a compulsion. Whatever words you choose, it’s a real thing. Caring for others and the environment, caring for the earth that nurtures us, the air we breathe and the water that helps us flourish. We’re not perfect, but we’re all responsible and we all have a part to play. Some small, some big. It’s in everything we do and always has been. We create products where beauty meets sustainability. And right now, it’s more important than ever.
Why? Because there’s no longer a choice between profit or people and planet. We’re entering a period in time where all of us have the chance to make a difference. With every action we take, with every decision we make. That’s why we’re choosing to leave the next generation a legacy, not a mess. We’re making the move to 100% circular design by 2035, a reduced CO2 footprint and long-term wellbeing of all our stakeholders.
What legacy do you want to leave?
Read our 2025 impact report
Brabantia has been a Certified B Corporation™ since March 2023. B Corps™ are companies verified against standards of social and environmental performance, transparency, and accountability. This certification aligns with our ambition to achieve 100% circular design by 2035 and supports our commitment to continuously improve the way we do business for people and the planet.
For decades, Brabantia has been helping people separate waste, keep food fresh for longer and dry laundry naturally. Now, we want to do even better: 100% circular design by 2035. And that means 100% material health, 100% clean wastewater, 100% renewable energy, 100% recycled production waste, 100% recycled/biobased materials and 100% recyclable products. We’re really going for it!
OUR SIX PILLARS TO 100% CIRCULAR DESIGN:
We want the materials we use during production, processing and use to be as safe as possible for people and the environment – safer than legally required, even. According to legislation, we already reached 100% safe materials. However, based on our own stricter standards, we achieved 99% in 2025 too.
We strive to minimise our energy use and want to ensure that all energy we do use comes from 100% renewable sources by 2035. In 2025, a change in our energy mix resulted in a small step forward.
We want our wastewater to be so clean that it can be processed into drinking water.
We improved waste collection in production and warehousing, our recycling rate slightly decreased to 91%.
This remains one of our most challenging ambitions – but we're making steady progress. In 2025, we increased to 53%, thanks to broader use of recycled plastic in our products like the Sort and Go Recycle Bins.
Our path to 100% recyclable products continues – though it's not always linear. A change in the product mix has resulted in an overall rate of 82%.
MORE CRADLE TO CRADLE® CERTIFICATION.
Our aim is to do better every year. Like raising the number of products that are Cradle to
Cradle® certified at silver level. In 2024, more products received Cradle-to-Cradle Silver
certification, bringing the share of in-house produced items with C2C certification to
83%. Today, Brabantia offers at least 700 Cradle-to-Cradle certified products, including
206 at Silver level—a result that reflects our commitment to meaningful, circular design.
ABOUT CRADLE TO CRADLE®
Cradle to Cradle® means that it is possible to reuse every raw material and material used for a product endlessly – without losing value. You can recognise products by the special Cradle to Cradle® certification. Products are assessed on five components: Safe materials, Reuse of materials, Clean air and climate protection, Water and soil management and Social responsibility. The main goal of Cradle to Cradle® design is a constant cycle of raw materials and thus the prevention of waste. There are five levels of certification.
The certificates are reviewed every two years. In order to maintain the high C2C score, we have to keep making our products more sustainable. It forces us to continue to keep pushing for more sustainability and circularity in our products
MATERIAL HEALTH.
Ensuring materials are safe for humans and the environment.
WATER & SOIL STEWARDSHIP.
Safeguarding clean water and healthy soils.
SOCIAL FAIRNESS.
Respecting human rights and contributing to a fair and equitable society.
CLEAN AIR & CLIMATE PROTECTION.
Protecting clean air, promoting renewable energy, and reducing harmful emissions.
PRODUCT CIRCULARITY.
Enabling a circular economy through regenerative products and process design.

Ensuring materials are safe for humans and the environment.
WATER & SOIL STEWARDSHIP.

SOCIAL FAIRNESS.

CLEAN AIR & CLIMATE PROTECTION.

PRODUCT CIRCULARITY.
Enabling a circular economy through regenerative products and process design.
LOVE TO RECYCLE.
The Sort & Go Recycle Bins are all you need to set up your own system for storing and sorting different types of waste. The small ones are ideal for disposal of organic waste, right on the kitchen counter. The bigger ones are great for bottles, cans, packaging or anything else you want sorted. And the best thing - soon made from 100% post-consumer recycled plastic!
BIG BA(N)G.
You want your bin liners to be strong and sustainable. In 2025, we have taken a next big step by moving from 35% to 100% recycled plastic* bin liners, whilst keeping the bags strong and perfect fit. From waste for waste!
*Excluding colourants and additives
100% RECYCLED, 100% RECYCLABLE.
Brabantia already scores 33% on use of recycled material in 2021 - 94% of the material of our products can be recycled after use to make new products.
A beautiful example: The NewIcon Pedal Bin 30 litres in Matt Steel is made of 68% recycled material (37% household waste and 31% industrial waste). Already 99.9% of this model can be reused.
100% RECYCLED, 100% RECYCLABLE.
Brabantia already scores 33% on use of recycled material in 2021 - 94% of the material of our products can be recycled after use to make new products.
A beautiful example: The NewIcon Pedal Bin 30 litres in Matt Steel is made of 68% recycled material (37% household waste and 31% industrial waste). Already 99.9% of this model can be reused.
STEPUP. THE NEXT STEP IN RECYCLING.
STEPUP. THE NEXT STEP IN RECYCLING.
The new StepUp Pedal Bins are made from and for recycled waste. First, they have a click-on label holder and free labels to set up your own personal recycling system. They’re affordable and space-saving too, so you can easily put two or three of them together. And after use, they are 99% recyclable. And their production is also pretty green: they are made from 91% household waste. No wonder these bins are Cradle to Cradle® Certified at silver level.
A BRIGHT FUTURE.
The StepUp collection is made to last. In addition, we offer a 10-year warranty. If something is broken, we will provide a replacement part or a replacement product. This way, the StepUp lasts even longer. A bin for the future.
More StepUp Pedal Bins
Made with 100% Fairtrade Cotton.
As of 2025, all Brabantia ironing board covers are now made with 100% Fairtrade cotton. This means that all of the cotton is Fairtrade certified, traded, audited and sourced from Fairtrade producers. The strict Fairtrade standards are designed to ensure farmers and workers are all safe, have good working conditions and are treated fairly – especially those in Asia, Africa and Latin-America. As well as protecting the environment  where Fairtrade cotton is grown. Choosing Fairtrade cotton for our ironing board covers is yet another step towards a fairer, more sustainable, and ethical world
View our ironing board covers made with Fairtrade cotton
A sustainable home: B.HOME.
In 2021, the construction of our new, sustainable head office ‘B.Home’ on the Leenderweg in Valkenswaard started. It’s on historic ground, as this is where our factory used to be. During the construction of the new building, the foundation of the old factory was reused. And that is just one example of the circularity and sustainability of our new home. There are many more, because the office is designed according to BREEAM principles. For example, the skeleton of the building is entirely made of wood and can easily be disassembled and reused.
On the roof, you will find sedum and a whopping 222 solar panels. Around the building we will we our own garden and we collect rainwater as much as possible. Some of the wall covering inside is made of recycled old army uniforms. The lamps are made from old CDs, the chairs from recycled PET bottles and the walls are painted with Fairf. This paint is made from plant material and therefore contributes to lowering the CO2 level. So B.Home is not just an office, but living proof of our desire to live and work sustainably.
BRABANTIA AND WEFOREST.
Brabantia has been working with WeForest since 2014. Since then, more than 3 million trees have been planted in the Amhara and Desa’a regions of Ethiopia and Burkina Faso.
The trees keep the fertile soil in place by sheltering the soil during heavy rainfall, they provide employment and will feed people, because WeForest also plants fruit and wood trees on farms
Discover
more
MORE SUSTAINABLE TOGETHER.
Together, we can make the world a more beautiful place. We’re happy to help with household tasks and support a more sustainable lifestyle. From separating
waste and preventing food waste to natural drying and reducing laundry loads: our products make everyday chores more enjoyable and more sustainable! How
beautiful is that?
Drying naturally.
Drying laundry on a rotary dryer or drying rack helps you save electricity - and keeps your clothes looking good for longer. And did you know the wind helps reduce creases too? That means less ironing when you dry naturally!
Rotary dryers
Separating waste in style.
Separating waste? Do it in style with our smart products. From handy waste bins with 1, 2 or 3 inner compartments to countertop trays and
stackable waste bins to set up your own recycling station with: we offer an extensive range to make separating waste more beautiful, pleasurable, and sustainable.

Pure Clean Linen<sup>®</sup>|Sprays|Glade<sup>®</sup> Sense & Spray<sup>®</sup> Automatic Spray
Pure Clean Linen® Glade® Sense & Spray Automatic Spray Holder 18ml
Keep it clean with air in any room of your home. Expertly crafted by master perfumers, this fragrance features invigorating notes of Crisp Air, Fresh Laundry, and the delicate scent of Lily of the Valley, infused with essential oils. With Smart Motion Technology, this motion-activated device provides up to 2 months* of fragrance per refill, offering an automatic boost to fill your home with your choice of scent.
(*Assuming an average of 6 times per day).
Fresh / Clean / Laundry
[image: NA]
Additional details
Benefits
The Glade® Sense & Spray® with 180° design offers the ultimate motion-activated fragrance experience, blending attractive design and a Smart Motion Sensor. For added control, a boost button can be pressed at any time for an extra burst of fragrance. Choose from a variety of masterfully crafted Glade® fragrances. To conserve the refill, the units have a lock-out mode of 20 minutes.
Safety
Extremely flammable.
Harmful to aquatic organisms.
Keep out of the reach of children.
Keep away from sources of ignition - no smoking.
Do not breathe spray.
In case of contact with eyes, rinse immediately with plenty of water and seek medical advice.
Use only in well-ventilated areas.
Protect from sunlight and do not expose to temperatures exceeding 50 °C.
Do not pierce or burn even after use.
Do not spray on a naked flame or any incandescent material.
People suffering from perfume sensitivity should be cautious when using this product.
Insert batteries correctly.
Do not recharge.
Do not open battery or dispose in fire. May explode, leak or cause damage.
Use "AA" alkaline batteries only.
Directions
Operation:
The smart unit automatically sprays fragrance when a shadow has been cast upon a sensor. To conserve the refill, the unit automatically enters a lock-out mode once it has detected motion and sprayed. The lock-out mode for Sense & Spray is 20 minutes. When in lock-out mode, the sensors are off and the unit will not automatically spray. After the lock-out mode time has expired, the unit is again ready to sense motion. For an instant burst of Glade® fragrance anytime, press the boost button on the top of the unit. Use only Glade® Sense & Spray® refills in this unit.
Placement:
For best results, place unit upright on a flat surface where upward spray will not be obstructed. Place unit within five feet of traffic flow.
Helpful hints:
The sensor may not respond if:
The room is too dark. Ensure there's sufficient lighting to allow a shadow to be cast upon sensor.
The unit is placed directly on or in a light source, especially sunlight. Move the unit out of the bright light.
Sensor on the front of the device is blocked by objects. Position the unit so that the sensor is unobstructed.
Caution:
Keep the unit pointed away from you and others during assembly. It automatically sprays a burst of fragrance after assembly to show it is working properly.
Assembly:
Sense & Spray – Lift front cover. To avoid misuse, make sure lever is pushed up before inserting refill. Lay cartridge into position over the brown tab. Snap cartridge into place ensuring brown tab protrudes from under the refill. You will hear a click to know the refill has been inserted correctly. Pull and discard red tab to activate batteries. To replace cartridge, lift front cover and remove the empty cartridge. If cartridge is not clicked into place, upon activation product may leak onto and damage surface. To install new cartridge, follow assembly instructions in steps 2 – 3. To replace batteries, lift front cover. Insert two new AA batteries.
Note:
Be sure that replacement batteries are positioned correctly. Unit will not function if batteries are installed backward.
FAQs & Tips
What is Glade® Sense & Spray® Air Freshener?
Glade® Sense & Spray® Air Freshener is a motion activated air freshener. It is a battery-operated device with a built-in motion sensor and concentrated mini-aerosol spray refill.
How does Glade® Sense & Spray® Air Freshener work?
The unit comes with 2 AA batteries and a mini-aerosol. Insert refill cartridge into bay. Cartridge should be placed on top of the brown pull tab (pull brown tab when replacing refill for easy removal.) Pull the red strip from the battery compartment, position unit upright on a flat surface and the motion sensor does the rest. A concentrated burst of fragrance is released with each spray.
How far away can you be from the sensor for it to still work?
The sensor works best when motion is within 1.5 metres (5 feet). For best results, ensure the sensors on the front of the unit are not obstructed.
Will the unit spray with every motion it detects?
No, after the unit has sprayed, in order to conserve the refill, the sensor will turn off automatically indicated by a solid light.
The lock-out mode for Sense & Spray is 20 minutes. If you want more fragrance during the lock-out time, simply press the boost button.
How long will the fragrance refill last?
Each refill provides approximately 340 sprays, which is about 30 days under normal usage conditions.
How long will the batteries last?
Battery life depends on several variables. It’s estimated that batteries will last 18 – 20 hours of device usage, approximately 2 – 3 refills.

Glade® Candle FAQs
How long can I burn a Glade® candle for?
For best performance, burn 2 to 4 hours at a time. This will maximise the life of your candle.
What is the best Glade® wick maintenance?
Wick maintenance is key for perfect burning. Trim the wick to 6.35 mm each time before you burn, and be sure to remove any wick debris in the candle before lighting.
Any tips on Glade® candle safety?
Do not touch, lift or move a burning candle. Wait until the wax has cooled and hardened before touching a candle. For optimal performance, keep burning candles away from drafts, vents and air currents. Candle wax can be temperature sensitive.For best performance, do not expose candles to extreme high or low temperatures.
Be sure the candleholder is placed on a stable, heat-resistant surface. Never place flammable materials, such as dry leaves or paper, near a candle. Never leave burning candles unattended. Do not burn candles where they can be knocked over by children, pets or anyone else.
How do I know when my candle is empty?
Stop using your Glade® Jar Candle, Glade 2in1 Candle or Large Candle when 6.35 mm of wax remains.
Can I reuse a Glade® candle holder?
Do not reuse candle holder; discard after use.
Glade® Aerosol Air Freshener FAQs
Do Glade® Air Fresheners contain CFCs?
No, Glade® Air Fresheners and all other SC Johnson aerosols have been chlorofluorocarbon (CFC) free since 1975.
Are Glade® Air Freshener cans recyclable?
Yes, Glade® Air Fresheners and other SC Johnson empty steel and aluminium aerosol cans can be recycled along with other empty steel and aluminium cans in many communities that operate recycling programmes.
Glade® Electric Scented Oils FAQs
How do I know when to replace the fragrance oil bottle?
Each see-through oil bottle provides a long-lasting fragrance. When empty, replace the fragrance oil bottle with Glade® PlugIns® refills only. All Glade® PlugIns® refills work in all Glade® PlugIns® warmer units.
I have read postings on the Internet alleging that Glade® PlugIns® products have been involved in fires. Are Glade® Plugins® a fire hazard?
SC Johnson is aware that there have been posts on the Internet that have claimed our products were involved in fires. It is important that you know that all our PlugIns® products are safe and will not cause fires. We know this because PlugIns® products have been sold for more than 15 years and hundreds of millions of them are being used safely.
Because we are committed to selling safe products, SC Johnson thoroughly investigated these rumours. First, we confirmed that no one had contacted SC Johnson to tell us about these fires or to ask us to investigate them. Additionally, we had a leading fire investigation expert call the fire service representative identified in one of the Internet posts. That fireman indicated that he has no evidence that our products had caused any fire.
We suspect this rumour may be associated with a past SC Johnson voluntary recall of one of its air products, a Glade® Extra Outlet Scented Oil product that was sold for a short period before 1 June 2002. After discovering an assembly error in a small number of that product, SC Johnson implemented a voluntary recall and provided extensive information about the product to the US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC). After revising the manufacturing process and thorough testing for proper assembly, the Glade® PlugIns® Scented Oil Extra Outlet product returned to shop shelves on 3 June 2002. SC Johnson has no knowledge of any credible reports of fire related to this product.
We also know that our products do not cause fires because all our PlugIns® products have been thoroughly tested by Underwriters Laboratories and other independent laboratories and our products meet or exceed safety requirements. SC Johnson continues to work closely with the Consumer Product Safety Commission to investigate allegations involving PlugIns® products.
As a more-than-100-year-old family-owned company, SC Johnson is committed to providing top-quality products that can be used safely in homes, and we want to reassure you that PlugIns® products can be used with complete confidence.
Can I clean the scented oil warmer?
Fragrance oils may collect on the warmer unit over time. To clean, remove the warmer from the electrical socket and wipe the warmer with a dry cloth. Wash hands after handling. These instructions are also included on the back of the warmer package.
What if the fragrance is too strong?
The fragrance will be stronger for the first 3 days and will then level off. You can control fragrance intensity by adjusting the control on the front of the unit. A lower setting provides less fragrance, while a higher setting provides the most fragrance.
What if the fragrance is too light?
First, check to make sure the socket is operating properly. This can be done by simply plugging in an appliance such as a lamp or a radio to make sure it is operating. If using the fan unit, make sure the warmer unit’s electrical plug is in the locked position with the arrows on the back of the unit aligned. The warmer unit should be plugged into the socket in a vertical or upright position.
Which Glade® PlugIns® refills will work with which warmer unit?
All Glade® PlugIns® refills work with any Glade® PlugIns® Scented Oil Warmers.
What’s the refill made of?
The bottle is plastic and is filled with fragrance oil.
Can I use this refill and the old refill at the same time in a dual warmer?
Yes.
Can I refill my bottle?
No, the refill bottles are not intended to be refilled. The Glade® PlugIns® Scented Oil fragrance is specially formulated to be safely used with the Glade® warmers.

That fireman indicated that he has no evidence that our products had caused any fire.
We suspect this rumour may be associated with a past SC Johnson voluntary recall of one of its air products, a Glade® Extra Outlet Scented Oil product that was sold for a short period before 1 June 2002. After discovering an assembly error in a small number of that product, SC Johnson implemented a voluntary recall and provided extensive information about the product to the US Consumer Product Safety Commission (CPSC). After revising the manufacturing process and thorough testing for proper assembly, the Glade® PlugIns® Scented Oil Extra Outlet product returned to shop shelves on 3 June 2002. SC Johnson has no knowledge of any credible reports of fire related to this product.
We also know that our products do not cause fires because all our PlugIns® products have been thoroughly tested by Underwriters Laboratories and other independent laboratories and our products meet or exceed safety requirements. SC Johnson continues to work closely with the Consumer Product Safety Commission to investigate allegations involving PlugIns® products.
As a more-than-100-year-old family-owned company, SC Johnson is committed to providing top-quality products that can be used safely in homes, and we want to reassure you that PlugIns® products can be used with complete confidence.
Can I clean the scented oil warmer?
Fragrance oils may collect on the warmer unit over time. To clean, remove the warmer from the electrical socket and wipe the warmer with a dry cloth. Wash hands after handling. These instructions are also included on the back of the warmer package.
What if the fragrance is too strong?
The fragrance will be stronger for the first 3 days and will then level off. You can control fragrance intensity by adjusting the control on the front of the unit. A lower setting provides less fragrance, while a higher setting provides the most fragrance.
What if the fragrance is too light?
First, check to make sure the socket is operating properly. This can be done by simply plugging in an appliance such as a lamp or a radio to make sure it is operating. If using the fan unit, make sure the warmer unit’s electrical plug is in the locked position with the arrows on the back of the unit aligned. The warmer unit should be plugged into the socket in a vertical or upright position.
Which Glade® PlugIns® refills will work with which warmer unit?
All Glade® PlugIns® refills work with any Glade® PlugIns® Scented Oil Warmers.
What’s the refill made of?
The bottle is plastic and is filled with fragrance oil.
Can I use this refill and the old refill at the same time in a dual warmer?
Yes.
Can I refill my bottle?
No, the refill bottles are not intended to be refilled. The Glade® PlugIns® Scented Oil fragrance is specially formulated to be safely used with the Glade® warmers.

Oral-B Electric Toothbrush FAQs
Why is an Oral-B iO electric toothbrush better than a manual toothbrush?
Oral-B electric toothbrushes are clinically proven to remove up to 100% more plaque compared to a regular manual toothbrush. All models also feature a built-in 2-minute timer, which help you brush for the dentist-recommended time. By improving your daily brushing habits and taking better care of your teeth and gums with an electric toothbrush, you reduce your risk of cavities, gingivitis, and other oral health issues.
What makes Oral-B iO electric toothbrushes different from other electric toothbrushes?
Oral-B iO represents our most advanced series of electric toothbrushes, developed with dentists to deliver Oral-B’s best clean.
Oral-B iO electric toothbrushes feature a unique round brush head, powered by a magnetic system that combines oscillating & rotating movements with gentle micro-vibrations.
Inspired by professional dental tools, the round iO brush head is designed to surround each tooth, providing a deep clean while remaining gentle on gums.
What is the difference between the different models in the iO series?
The Oral-B iO range offers an option for every brushing style and need.
The iO2 offers a streamlined design with essential features only for simple, effective cleaning. The iO10 is our most premium brush, designed to deliver a truly luxury brushing experience.
As you move up the range, you’ll benefit from enhanced features such as smarter feedback, more brushing modes, and greater personalisation – helping you get the most out of every brush.
Which toothbrush head fits my Oral-B toothbrush?
Oral-B iO Electric Toothbrushes are compatible with Oral-B iO Toothbrush Heads only.
Earlier Oral-B models, such as Oral-B Genius, Smart, Vitality & Pro, are compatible with Oral-B Pro Toothbrush Heads only.
To ensure the best performance and a secure fit, always choose the brush head specifically designed for your toothbrush model.

Hello,
We are happy that you are visiting our website to learn more about ingredients that are used in toothpaste and why we use them.
What is used in a toothpaste is also listed on its packaging so you know what we put inside and what not. There are active and inactive ingredients in a toothpaste. Some are just needed to make sure the paste stays a paste over time or to offer a delightful brushing experience.
WHAT WILL YOU FIND IN ORAL-B TOOTHPASTES
INGREDIENTS
STANNOUS FLUORIDE
PURPOSE
Anti-cavity, maintains healthy condition of gums
WHAT IT DOES
It forms a micro-thin shield that protects against dietary acids and Inhibits production of plaque.
Helps to: prevent cavities, protects against plaque regrowth, maintains gums in a healthy condition and protects against sensitivity and bad breath.
INGREDIENTS
STANNOUS CHLORIDE
PURPOSE
Stabilizing Agent maintains healthy condition of gums
WHAT IT DOES
Helps stabilizing the toothpastes’ formulation.
Helps to: protects against plaque regrowth, maintains gums in a healthy condition and protects against sensitivity.
INGREDIENTS
FLUORIDE (E.G. SODIUM CHLORIDE)
PURPOSE
Anti-cavity Active Ingredient
WHAT IT DOES
Fluoride helps prevent tooth decay by slowing the breakdown of enamel. This increases the resistance to future acid challenges.
WHO, FDI, IADR and CSA have recently reaffirmed the efficacy and safety of fluoride.
INGREDIENTS
ZINC (LACTATE, CITRATE)
PURPOSE
Anti-Tartar build-up + Anti Bacteria active ingredient
WHAT IT DOES
Eliminates sources of bad breath that cause bad breath, protects against plaque, prevents tartar build-up and cares for gums.
INGREDIENTS
GLYCERIN
PURPOSE
Humectant
WHAT IT DOES
Provides a pleasant brushing experience through keeping the toothpaste’s level of viscosity in balance.
It holds ingredients together and helps prevent the product from drying out.
INGREDIENTS
HYDRATED SILICA
PURPOSE
Cleaning
WHAT IT DOES
Whiter teeth through cleaning, polishing and gently removing surface stains, while protecting the enamel.
Silica removes surface stains when combined with mechanical action from toothbrush.
INGREDIENTS
CHALK (CALCIUM CARBONATE)
PURPOSE
Cleaning
WHAT IT DOES
Whiter teeth through cleaning, polishing and gently removing surface stains, while protecting the enamel.
INGREDIENTS
SODIUM HEXAMETA-PHOSPHATE
PURPOSE
Anti-Tartar & Stain Prevention
WHAT IT DOES
Helps prevents tartar build-up. Removes and helps prevents surface stains.
INGREDIENTS
PROPYLENE GLYCOL
PURPOSE
Humectant
WHAT IT DOES
Provides a pleasant brushing experience through keeping the toothpaste’s level of viscosity in balance.
It holds ingredients together and helps prevent the product from drying out.
INGREDIENTS
PEG (PEG-6 / PEG-20M / PEG-23M)
PURPOSE
Humectant
WHAT IT DOES
PEG is an ingredient that helps hold components of the toothpaste together. It has high solubility in water and helps with foaming action for a more pleasant brushing experience.
PEG-6 (polyethylene glycol 6) is not to be confused with ordinary Polyethylene, both are different chemical compounds.
INGREDIENTS
WATER
PURPOSE
Solvent, carrier ingredient
WHAT IT DOES
Hydrates and dissolves many ingredients.
INGREDIENTS
TRISODIUM PHOSPHATE
PURPOSE
pH Buffer
WHAT IT DOES
Maintains pH of the product for efficacy and integrity.
INGREDIENTS
FLAVOUR (LIMONENE, AROMA, CI 74160)
PURPOSE
Flavour & Cooling ingredient
WHAT IT DOES
Aesthetic Component that helps improving the taste of the toothpaste and your overall brushing experience.
Ingredients in the toothpaste that help clean and protect your teeth like Fluoride and abrasives do not taste delicious on their own.
INGREDIENTS
SODIUM LAURYL SULFATE
PURPOSE
Foaming Agent
WHAT IT DOES
Foaming and cleaning agent that helps to dislodge food particles, bacteria and plaque and helps pull stains away from teeth.
Even though there are debates about SLS, the way how it is being used in toothpaste is non-problematic.
In fact, SLS has been tested in multiple clinical studies with no indication that it is a contact allergen.
The safety of SLS has not been questioned by the European Commission, nor its expert advisory committee (SCCS), nor by any of the member states.
INGREDIENTS
SODIUM GLUCONATE
PURPOSE
Stabilizer Agent
WHAT IT DOES
Maintains efficacy of Stannous Fluoride by stabilizing it.
INGREDIENTS
CARRAGEENAN
PURPOSE
Binder, thickener
WHAT IT DOES
Delivers the right toothpaste consistency.
INGREDIENTS
SODIUM SACCHARIN
PURPOSE
Sweetener
WHAT IT DOES
Aesthetic Component that helps improving the taste of the toothpaste and your overall brushing experience.
Ingredients in the toothpaste that help clean and protect your teeth like Fluoride and abrasives do not taste delicious on their own. While this ingredient gives a sweet taste, our toothpastes do not contain sugar!
INGREDIENTS
XANTHAN GUM
PURPOSE
Binder, thickener
WHAT IT DOES
Delivers the right toothpaste consistency.
INGREDIENTS
COLOUR & AESTHETICS (MICA, SPECKLES)
PURPOSE
Colour, aesthetics
WHAT IT DOES
Aesthetic Component that delights you and your overall brushing experience.
Makes a toothpaste sparkle.
INGREDIENTS
SORBITOL
PURPOSE
Humectant, carrier ingredient
WHAT IT DOES
Provides a pleasant brushing experience through keeping the toothpaste’s level of viscosity in balance.
It holds ingredients together and helps prevent the product from drying out.
Protects against growth of plaque/bacteria.
INGREDIENTS
HYDROXYETHYL CELLULOSE
PURPOSE
Binder, thickener
WHAT IT DOES
Delivers the right toothpaste consistency.
INGREDIENTS
SODIUM CITRATE
PURPOSE
pH Buffer
WHAT IT DOES
Maintains pH for product effectiveness.
INGREDIENTS
TITANIUM DIOXIDE (CI 77981)
PURPOSE
Makes toothpaste white
WHAT IT DOES
It is an ingredient frequently used in cosmetic products as a colorant. Creates the white look of a toothpaste.
Even though there are debates about Titanium Dioxide, the way how it is being used in toothpaste is non-problematic. It is safe to use as per EU-Cosmetics Regulation.
INGREDIENTS
COCAMIDOPROPYL BETAINE
PURPOSE
Foaming agent
WHAT IT DOES
Foaming and cleaning agent that helps to dislodge food particles, bacteria and plaque and helps pull stains away from teeth.
INGREDIENTS
PYROPHOSPHATE (DISODIUM PYROPHOSPHATE, TETRASODIUM PYROPHOSPHATE)
PURPOSE
Anti-Tartar and stain removal Ingredient
WHAT IT DOES
These ingredients help prevent the formation of tartar and stains.
INGREDIENTS
BAKING SODA (SODIUM BICARBONATE)
PURPOSE
pH agent cleaning ingredient
WHAT IT DOES
Baking soda taste, delightful experience.
