L4@P0-1: ANIMAL WELFARE POLICYLatest Version Date June 2020 Doc Ref Animal Welfare Policy
L5@P1: Version Number 2.0 Page 2 of 5
L6@P1: Public Copy
L7@P1: BACKGROUND
L8@P1: Marks and Spencer are committed to using responsibly sourced raw materials including the
L9@P1: use of products derived from animals. This policy forms part of our commitment to uphold
L10@P1: the M&S animal welfare principles for all animal derived products we source.
L11@P1: SCOPE
L12@P1: This policy covers products sold in all Clothing, Home and Beauty areas that contain any
L13@P1: animal derived raw materials. The scope includes all main fabrics/textiles, trims,
L14@P1: componentry packaging, chemicals, pigments and dyestuffs.
L15@P1: This policy is intended to complement the additional specific sourcing policies for
L16@P1: Cashmere, Wool, Leather and Feather and Down.
L17@P1: RATONALE AND OBJECTIVES
L18@P1: • To ensure Marks & Spencer meets its long-standing commitment to improve animal
L19@P1: welfare in its supply chains and ensure all animal derived materials are sourced from
L20@P1: farms with good animal welfare practices. Marks & Spencer are committed to
L21@P1: improving animal welfare across our global supply chains and we are working to
L22@P1: source all animal-derived materials from farms with good animal welfare practices
L23@P1: • To lay out a set of uniform principles and guidelines around the sourcing of animal
L24@P1: derived raw materials
L25@P1: • To also ensure that appropriate due diligence is undertaken with regards to the
L26@P1: sourcing of products in relation to animal welfare
L27@P1: M&S MANDATORY PRINCIPLES FOR SOURCING
L28@P1: Marks and Spencer are committed to protecting any endangered or vulnerable species and
L29@P1: to the prevention of cruelty. Through our supply chains we seek to promote, encourage and
L30@P1: foster higher animal welfare standards using codes, recommendations and audited supply
L31@P1: chains. We will continuously review our supply chains and where there are practices that
L32@P1: are of concern, we will take a considered course of action.
L33@P1: No animal will be slaughtered specifically for the manufacture or sourcing of M&S products.
L34@P1: PROHIBITED SOURCES
L35@P1: The following materials do not comply with our business principles for animal welfare and
L36@P1: therefore must not be used in any of our non-food products:
L37@P1: • Any material from any endangered species, defined as those which appear on the
L38@P1-2: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES) (see www.cites.org/ Latest Version Date June 2020 Doc Ref Animal Welfare Policy
L39@P2: Version Number 2.0 Page 3 of 5
L40@P2: Public Copy
L41@P2: for list of species) or the IUCN red list as Critically Endangered,
L42@P2: Endangered or Vulnerable (www.redlist.org/).
L43@P2: • No animal must be slaughtered specifically to produce any non- food M&S products.
L44@P2: • Fur: this includes farmed fur (e.g. fox, sable, mink, chinchilla, rabbit)
L45@P2: • Angora Rabbit fibre
L46@P2: • Alpaca fibre
L47@P2: • Astrakhan (Karakul) or any other leather/skin products which are the product of
L48@P2: unnatural abortions
L49@P2: • Any material obtained from live skinning (e.g. reptiles) or live boiling
L50@P2: • Any cow hides sourced from India
L51@P2: • Any animal derived bone or horn
L52@P2: • Any down or feathers from exotic birds, including but not limited to ostrich
L53@P2: • Any coral
L54@P2: RESTRICTED SOURCES
L55@P2: The following materials are currently accepted provided minimum requirements are met:
L56@P2: • Leather must be sourced in compliance with our Responsible Leather Sourcing Policy
L57@P2: • Animal Fibres (e.g. wool, cashmere) must be sourced in compliance with our Responsible
L58@P2: Wool Sourcing Policy and our Cashmere Code of Practice for animal welfare respectively.
L59@P2: All wool must be sourced from sheep that have not been mulesed
L60@P2: • Mohair must only be sourced through routes fully certified to the Textile Exchange
L61@P2: Responsible Mohair Standard (RMS)
L62@P2: • Feather and Down must not be obtained from the live plucking of birds or from birds used
L63@P2: in the production of Foie Gras. All Feather and Down must be sourced in compliance to
L64@P2: our Responsible Feather and Down Sourcing Policy
L65@P2: • All other animal derived materials must be sourced in accordance with this policy and
L66@P2: relevant details must be provided on an Animal derived material declaration form
L67@P2: • Any shell from vulnerable or endangered species must not be used (as defined by
L68@P2: CITES/IUCN red list)
L69@P2-3: • Only pearls form cultivated sources are allowed Latest Version Date June 2020 Doc Ref Animal Welfare Policy
L70@P3: Version Number 2.0 Page 4 of 5
L71@P3: Public Copy
L72@P3: THE FIVE FREEDOMS OF ANIMAL WELFARE
L73@P3: In developing minimum standards for sourcing any animal product Marks & Spencer
L74@P3: consider the internationally recognised “Five Freedoms” as a framework and for guidance. It
L75@P3: is important that the sourcing of any animal derived materials for M&S are underpinned by
L76@P3: these principles:
L77@P3: 1. Freedom from Hunger and Thirst – by ready access to fresh water and a diet to
L78@P3: maintain full health and vigour
L79@P3: 2. Freedom from Discomfort – by providing an appropriate environment including
L80@P3: shelter and a comfortable resting area
L81@P3: 3. Freedom from Pain, Injury and Disease – by prevention or rapid diagnosis and
L82@P3: treatment
L83@P3: 4. Freedom to Express Normal Behaviour – by providing sufficient space, proper
L84@P3: facilities and company of the animal’s own kind
L85@P3: 5. Freedom from Fear and Distress – by ensuring conditions and treatment which
L86@P3: avoid mental suffering
L87@P3: ANIMAL TESTING
L88@P3: Marks and Spencer will not conduct or commission any tests on animals. All M&S own brand
L89@P3: cosmetic and household products and ingredients must be approved by the BUAV under
L90@P3: the Humane Cosmetics Standard, The Leaping Bunny Standard. This standard has been in
L91@P3: place since January 2006
L92@P3: PET ACCESSORIES
L93@P3: Any pet accessories are subject to all mandatory principles for sourcing. In addition, the
L94@P3: product itself must not compromise the welfare of the animal for which it is intended to be
L95@P3: used, using the Five Freedoms as a reference.
L96@P3: PRODUCT PROMOTION
L97@P3: Marks and Spencer will review all animal imagery used in the promotion of its products to
L98@P3: ensure that it does not endorse animal exploitation, cruelty or irresponsible use or
L99@P3: ownership.
L100@P3: DEFINITIONS
L101@P3: Animals: The Vegan Society understands the word animal to refer to the entire animal
L102@P3-4: kingdom, that is all vertebrates and multi-cellular invertebrates. The word may be used either Latest Version Date June 2020 Doc Ref Animal Welfare Policy
L103@P4: Version Number 2.0 Page 5 of 5
L104@P4: Public Copy
L105@P4: as a noun or an adjective and to refer to a species, or an individual animal,
L106@P4: depending on context.
L107@P4: Animal derived materials: Materials including ingredients that have an animal (see above
L108@P4: definition), origin, regardless of whether they have been harvested form live or dead
L109@P4: animals.

L1003: Have a wild birthday with this exciting birthday multipack, with 2 gift bags, tissue paper and a birthday card, this pack is the perfect way to make their birthday extra special. L4@P0-1: ANIMAL WELFARE POLICYLatest Version Date June 2020 Doc Ref Animal Welfare Policy
L5@P1: Version Number 2.0 Page 2 of 5
L6@P1: Public Copy
L7@P1: BACKGROUND
L8@P1: Marks and Spencer are committed to using responsibly sourced raw materials including the
L9@P1: use of products derived from animals. This policy forms part of our commitment to uphold
L10@P1: the M&S animal welfare principles for all animal derived products we source.
L11@P1: SCOPE
L12@P1: This policy covers products sold in all Clothing, Home and Beauty areas that contain any
L13@P1: animal derived raw materials. The scope includes all main fabrics/textiles, trims,
L14@P1: componentry packaging, chemicals, pigments and dyestuffs.
L15@P1: This policy is intended to complement the additional specific sourcing policies for
L16@P1: Cashmere, Wool, Leather and Feather and Down.
L17@P1: RATONALE AND OBJECTIVES
L18@P1: • To ensure Marks & Spencer meets its long-standing commitment to improve animal
L19@P1: welfare in its supply chains and ensure all animal derived materials are sourced from
L20@P1: farms with good animal welfare practices. Marks & Spencer are committed to
L21@P1: improving animal welfare across our global supply chains and we are working to
L22@P1: source all animal-derived materials from farms with good animal welfare practices
L23@P1: • To lay out a set of uniform principles and guidelines around the sourcing of animal
L24@P1: derived raw materials
L25@P1: • To also ensure that appropriate due diligence is undertaken with regards to the
L26@P1: sourcing of products in relation to animal welfare
L27@P1: M&S MANDATORY PRINCIPLES FOR SOURCING
L28@P1: Marks and Spencer are committed to protecting any endangered or vulnerable species and
L29@P1: to the prevention of cruelty. Through our supply chains we seek to promote, encourage and
L30@P1: foster higher animal welfare standards using codes, recommendations and audited supply
L31@P1: chains. We will continuously review our supply chains and where there are practices that
L32@P1: are of concern, we will take a considered course of action.
L33@P1: No animal will be slaughtered specifically for the manufacture or sourcing of M&S products.
L34@P1: PROHIBITED SOURCES
L35@P1: The following materials do not comply with our business principles for animal welfare and
L36@P1: therefore must not be used in any of our non-food products:
L37@P1: • Any material from any endangered species, defined as those which appear on the
L38@P1-2: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES) (see www.cites.org/ Latest Version Date June 2020 Doc Ref Animal Welfare Policy
L39@P2: Version Number 2.0 Page 3 of 5
L40@P2: Public Copy
L41@P2: for list of species) or the IUCN red list as Critically Endangered,
L42@P2: Endangered or Vulnerable (www.redlist.org/).
L43@P2: • No animal must be slaughtered specifically to produce any non- food M&S products.
L44@P2: • Fur: this includes farmed fur (e.g. fox, sable, mink, chinchilla, rabbit)
L45@P2: • Angora Rabbit fibre
L46@P2: • Alpaca fibre
L47@P2: • Astrakhan (Karakul) or any other leather/skin products which are the product of
L48@P2: unnatural abortions
L49@P2: • Any material obtained from live skinning (e.g. reptiles) or live boiling
L50@P2: • Any cow hides sourced from India
L51@P2: • Any animal derived bone or horn
L52@P2: • Any down or feathers from exotic birds, including but not limited to ostrich
L53@P2: • Any coral
L54@P2: RESTRICTED SOURCES
L55@P2: The following materials are currently accepted provided minimum requirements are met:
L56@P2: • Leather must be sourced in compliance with our Responsible Leather Sourcing Policy
L57@P2: • Animal Fibres (e.g. wool, cashmere) must be sourced in compliance with our Responsible
L58@P2: Wool Sourcing Policy and our Cashmere Code of Practice for animal welfare respectively.
L59@P2: All wool must be sourced from sheep that have not been mulesed
L60@P2: • Mohair must only be sourced through routes fully certified to the Textile Exchange
L61@P2: Responsible Mohair Standard (RMS)
L62@P2: • Feather and Down must not be obtained from the live plucking of birds or from birds used
L63@P2: in the production of Foie Gras. All Feather and Down must be sourced in compliance to
L64@P2: our Responsible Feather and Down Sourcing Policy
L65@P2: • All other animal derived materials must be sourced in accordance with this policy and
L66@P2: relevant details must be provided on an Animal derived material declaration form
L67@P2: • Any shell from vulnerable or endangered species must not be used (as defined by
L68@P2: CITES/IUCN red list)

Ravenhead
Ravenhead dates back to a factory based at St Helens in North West England in 1842, an area renowned for its glassmaking. Primarily producing bottles, Ravenhead in the 1930s branched out into domestic tableware such as bowls, jugs and drinking glasses.

The Ravenhead Selected collection includes premium glassware such as Winchester, Gemstone, Mystique, Roma and Pisa. They are all uniquely designed to add a touch of luxury to a dining table.

The Ravenhead Essentials collection is a comprehensive range of high quality, dishwasher safe, resilient glassware, perfect for everyday use.

Entertain
The Entertain collection includes an extensive range of specialist cocktail glasses in a variety of shapes and sizes. From contemporary, oversized gin balloon glasses to the traditional cocktail saucer, each is made from durable, quality glass ideal for presenting an array of cocktail creations.
[image: Majestic Glassware] [image: Majestic Glassware]
Majestic
The Majestic collection is perfect for enjoying a variety of wines. This elegant and distinctive shape is crafted using a one-piece pulled stem which is perfect for cradling the glass.
[image: Mode Glassware] [image: Mode Glassware]
Mode
The Mode glassware is elegant and practical, specifically designed to meet the needs of the family. The glasses are fine-blown in one piece, providing extra strength and durability to the glass.
[image: Tulip Glassware] [image: Tulip Glassware]
Tulip
The Tulip collection is a classic, functional range of glassware perfect for any household. These highly transparent, durable glasses also benefit from being the perfect size for dishwasher loading.
[image: Luna Glassware] [image: Luna Glassware]
Luna
The Luna glassware range has everything you need to add a stylish, eye-catching look to your table or living space. The contemporary shape, generous size and heavy base are accentuated further by their high clarity and durability.
Regency Gold
The Regency Gold range features a collection of glassware with a heavy base which makes each one feel well-balanced in the hand and pleasing to hold.

The Sphere glasses add a touch of sophistication to your entertaining experience with smooth round sides and long elegant stems.
Ravenhead
In the 1970s, Ravenhead was in its hey-day. It was the largest maker of table glass in the UK and was exporting to over 100 countries, producing 200 million glasses per year. During this time, leading designers created much-loved ranges such as Siesta, Barmaster, Elegance, White Fire, Apollo & Solar. In 1973, Ravenhead produced the well-known blue Vicks pots and Milk of Magnesia bottles for the pharmaceutical industry.
Thanks to Ravenhead’s first TV advertising campaign in 1972, its popularity grew and items such as the best-selling White Fire range were commonly requested as wedding gifts and remarkable sales followed.

Ravenhead History
Viners has a long and illustrious history as a family of silversmiths in the UK since the late 19th century. Establishing their first manufacturing business in 1908 in Sheffield, specialising in plated holloware, they were one of the first businesses to introduce new cutting edge production techniques.
After the First World War, Viners diversified into cutlery production and became leading cutlers within the marketplace. Viners were the first cutlers to utilise real marketing strategies; specifically designed packaging and advertising campaigns led to Viners being the most recognised cutlery brand in the UK.
With a clear directive for innovative design, Viners employed eminent designers to create classic designs that can still be found in homes today. The iconic Studio range still exists within the Viners portfolio today and continues to be one of our most popular and expanding designs within the range. Today Viners is focused on building the brand and developing leading exclusive designs.

Corporate Social Responsibility
Our Responsibilities
Our goal is to become a fully sustainable business with a strong ethical and environmental stance. We aim to produce beautiful, functional products with a positive impact on our colleagues, our customers and the environment.
Our commitment to current and future generations has influenced our product design for a number of years and will continue to do so for many more. To reduce the environmental impact of our packaging, we strive to support the development of sustainable materials used in the manufacturing process of our products and recycle more packaging than we use. We champion improvements to sustainable manufacturing and fully support the recycling industry.
A number of the products we manufacture are made from sustainable materials such a glass, bamboo-fibre, wheat-fibre and corn to reduce the use of plastics. Our products are made with materials that are hard wearing, long lasting and never single use.
We continually work to innovate and redesign our packaging using less material and incorporating more recycled and renewable materials.
All of our single sided labels are made from 100% recycled paper and all packaging collated in our warehouse is returned into the supply chain to be reused.
With the help of our service provider, B&M Waste, all by-products from our warehouse are diverted away from landfills, and instead go to a Refuse Derived Fuel Facility. At the RDF facility, waste is used to form blocks that are then used as fuel to power other processes.
Environmental, Social and Governance Strategy Project (ESG)
The Rayware Groups’ ESG Strategy provides a framework to assess and manage Rayware’s impact on the world in terms of people, planet and profit. This ESG strategy offers a key to sustainability and resilience.
By having an ESG Strategy, Rayware will have identified the work that is currently business as usual alongside its goals and objectives for the future. This will help to maintain our longstanding relationships with stakeholders including employees, suppliers and customers as well as helping to safeguard our business against future risks.
To read The Rayware Group's ESG Strategy, click here
The wellbeing of our colleagues at The Rayware Group is paramount. We strive to maintain the highest standards of workplace health, both physically and mentally.
Our Health and Safety project team run periodical audits on all our sites, and identify areas for improvement which are implemented within a 1 – 3 month time frame.
The Rayware Group continually invests in programs that will benefit our staff in the workplace as well as in the home.
Health and Wellbeing coaches and experts from several organisations are invited in to The Rayware Group offices to provide advice and discuss methods on how to better deal with the stresses of work and life.
Our staff are frequently organising monthly friendly football matches, fitness classes and group fun runs to encourage a healthy lifestyle outside of the office.

We have put together some of our most frequently asked questions. Please take your time to read as you may find the answer right here! For further help, telephone: 0151 486 1888 or email: trade@rayware.co.uk and we will be happy to assist.
Who is Rayware?
The Rayware Group is the creative home of a group of British heritage with products that span both the housewares and tabletop industries. Brands consisting of Kilner®, Mason Cash®, Viners®, Typhoon®, Price and Kensington® and Ravenhead® are designed and developed in the United Kingdom with our customers in mind.
Throughout the years our business has grown, but our aim has remained the same; to offer a wide variety of choice to reflect emerging trends, exciting colours and well-designed quality products with good value price points. Every product is manufactured to the company's own exclusive design and specification, and all products are packaged to a high standard, ensuring attractive retail displays and rapid sales.
To read more about us and our journey, check out Our Story Page.
Why did I have to fill out all that information to become a customer?
As a business, we need to have all of your billing information before making you a customer. This involves a number of internal processes that we have to complete, so although it may take a while to complete all of the information before becoming a customer, in the long run, we promise it will be worth it!
I'd like to see your prices in Euro's instead of UK Sterling.
When you register with us, dependent on your details we will set your account to show our product pricing in either UK Sterling or Euro’s. If you want to change this, please contact us and let us know, or call directly on +44 (0)151 486 1888.
What is the quickest way to place an order?
We have introduced a 'Quick Order' form which you will find listed in your 'My Account' dashboard. If you know the codes of the products that you wish to order, all you need to do is type in the code and the quantity required. The product name and details will automatically be filled in. Once you have finished adding codes simply click on the ‘add to basket’ button.
If you have already placed an order with us and want to re-order items from a previous order, simply click on the re-order button in your dashboard. This will add all of the products on your previous order to your basket which you can then adjust, for example you can remove products that you do not wish to re-order and adjust the quantity of those that you do.
I just want to browse through the site to see what is there but I don't want to place an order online
This is fine, you can email your order through to our sales team at sales@rayware.co.uk. Our sales team are available between 9am - 5pm, Monday to Friday. However, if you’re worried about the security of placing an order online, please don’t be. Our trade site is SSL encrypted to give you a completely secure connection.
I want to find a mixing bowl to add to my order. What do I do?
The site navigation has been made much simpler now for the user. There are 2 ways to locate a particular product:
You can use the search facility in the top right of the menu, just add the words ‘mixing bowl’, the item code, or product name and it will search the whole site for you and bring every product relating to the word or number onto one page.
You can use the ‘Product’ menu at the top of the page. Every item within The Rayware Group has been re-categorised to fall into one of these sections. Mixing bowls are within both the Baking and the Tools, utensils and food preparation categories. You can then refine your results using the filters at the left hand side of the page.
I only want to see what is available under the Mason Cash brand
It is now much easier to find products under specific brands. Use the brands drop down on the top menu bar and choose Mason Cash. You will then be shown the ranges within the brand that you have selected.
If you are a trade customer, you can download the latest Mason Cash catalogue by choosing Mason Cash from the brands drop down on the top menu bar and clicking the 'Catalogue' button.
How do I find out who my Area Sales Representative is?
When you register on our site you will automatically be assigned an Area Sales Representative. Their details will be displayed at the top of your dashboard.
How do I order products from a previous order?
Every order you’ve placed with us over the past 12 months is stored in 'your orders' which can be found in your dashboard. This section allows you to track your current orders and to view products from your previous orders. Just select which order you want to view by clicking on the date link. You can then view all the products, and add any specific items you want to your current order.
I've added too many cartons of a product to my order. How can I reduce the number?
Click on the basket link at the top of the page, this will bring up the list of items which are currently in your basket. Find the product that you wish to update then alter the quantity using either the plus or minus buttons or by typing the correct quantity into the carton quantity box. Products can also be completely removed from your order by clicking on the ‘delete’ button. If you have already placed your order and checked out please call us on 0151 486 1888 and we will update the order for you.
I'd like to use some of the product images on your site. How can I do this?
On each product page we have added a ‘Download product images’ button. This will take you to a folder which displays all of our product images which are labelled by code. Simply highlight the image that you want to save by clicking on it once, then right click and choose ‘save as’ to save it to your computer. If you want to choose multiple images, hold down the shift or control button which allows you to select multiple images at once. Then right click and choose ‘save as’ to save them to your computer.
Can I change or cancel my order?
If you have already placed your order and checked out, please call us on 0151 486 1888 or email our Sales Team - sales@rayware.co.uk and we will update the order for you. Please note that if your order has already been processed it may not be possible to amend an order.
If you would like to cancel your order, please call us on 0151 486 1888 or email our Sales Team - sales@rayware.co.uk and we will do our best to try and help you. However, please note we are only able to cancel an order before it has been released from our warehouse.
What payment methods are available?
We accept all major credit and debit cards including Visa, Delta, Visa Electron, MasterCard and Maestro.
We accept all major credit and debit cards including Visa, Delta, Visa Electron, MasterCard and Maestro.
How long will delivery take?
Delivery usually takes 3 – 5 working days from receipt of payment. Please refer to our delivery page for more information.
Delivery usually takes 3 – 5 working days from receipt of payment. Please refer to our delivery page for more information.
What are your delivery options?
Delivery is calculated based on the weight of your order, carton sizes and the delivery postcode. Free delivery is available if you spend over £750. The cart will show how much more you need to spend to qualify for free delivery.
If you do not wish to pay for delivery, you can choose to collect your goods from our warehouse.
Delivery is calculated based on the size of your order and the delivery postcode. Free delivery is available if you spend over £500. The cart will show how much more you need to spend to qualify for free delivery.
If you do not wish to pay for delivery, you can choose to collect your goods from our warehouse.
Can I return my item/s?
For information on how to make a return please refer to our delivery and claims page.
For information on how to make a return please refer to our delivery and claims page.
Who can buy from the Rayware Group?
We only sell to trade customers through this website. If you have a registered company and would like to open up an account with us, please complete the online ‘register for an account’ form.
We unfortunately do not sell directly to the public through this site but please visit our brand consumer sites using the links below to find a stockist and to view our recipes and product inspiration.

What is the minimum order?
We have no minimum order! However, to qualify for free delivery you must spend over £750.
What if an item is damaged or missing from my order?
We're so sorry there was a problem with your order! Please refer to our delivery and claims page for how to get in touch and we will sort it out for you.
We're so sorry there was a problem with your order! Please refer to our delivery and returns page for how to get in touch and we will sort it out for you.
Do you ship to Europe or the US?
We currently only ship to UK & Ireland from our trade website. Please contact our export department on export@rayware.co.uk for more info on buying our products and international delivery.
We currently only ship to UK & Ireland from our trade website. Please contact our export department on export@rayware.co.uk for more info on buying our products and international delivery.
The site looks completely different to the last time I placed an order. What has happened?
The Rayware trade site has had a complete make over in order to make it much more user friendly. We spent time researching what our customers liked about the old site and what they didn’t. We then used this feedback as a base to improve it.
The main improvements include a quick order form, an easier re-ordering process and dedicated brand pages which reflect the look and feel of our consumer websites. There is also a dashboard page where you can easily find your account details, your wish list, orders and promotions that are tailored to your business type, along with details of new products that have been added. The new products list is updated hourly so you have access to stock availability and pricing in an instant. Our ideal is to make your shopping experience better, and we will continue to ask for feedback and improve the site further as time goes on.
I have a complaint, what should I do?
Here at the Rayware Group we want our customers to be delighted with every order placed and we will endeavour to give all our customers the very best service. However in the unlikely event that you feel you have a complaint with regards to any part of the service received please see the following guidelines:
In the first instance please contact our trade customer service department in writing either via the post or email trade@rayware.co.uk and clearly title your email ‘complaint’. Please give the full details of your complaint and include your order reference number, customer name and if possible any important dates. A Trade Customer Care representative will get back to you with a response in writing within 3 working days.
If you are not satisfied with the response received from our Customer Care department you can escalate your complaint with our customer services manager. Please give full details of why you are not happy with the response you have received from our customer services department in writing either by post or via email. Please attach your original complaint and the response you have received already from our customer service department. We will respond to you within 3 working days of your complaint.

why are the teats flattened?
when breastfeeding, baby flattens mum’s nipple in their mouth - that’s why our breast like teats are flattened, helping to reduce bottle confusion and make bottle feeding as comfortable and natural as possible
what is the Flexzone™?
the FlexZone™ is the flexible part around the bottle teat that allows it to move and flex just like mum’s breast does when feeding
are they anti-colic?
our triple anti-colic valves do the heavy lifting by reducing air intake during feeds and preventing colic symptoms. Colic is a common issue in young babies and is often caused by digestive or feeding problems, which are linked to swallowing air while feeding. This can lead to discomfort and make feeding and settling baby stressful for everyone
Keeping a consistent feeding routine, ensuring your baby is in a comfortable position while feeding, and using a bottle designed to minimise air intake can help make feeding times more relaxed for everyone involved
how will I know?
healthcare professionals agree that the most common signs of colic include intense bouts of crying, when your baby seems otherwise healthy. Other indicators can include clenching their fists, drawing their knees up to their tummy, or appearing tense and agitated
what flow do I need?
we offer a variety of teats in varying flow rates. Remember, every baby is different and this is just a guide:
• 0m+ Newborn Flow: perfect for newborns, offering a slow, gentle start
• 1m+ Slow Flow: perfect for babies that are getting into the swing of feeding and newborns with a bigger appetite
• 3m+ Medium Flow: as baby grows, so does their appetite! Switch to medium if you notice they’re taking a long time to feed or are getting frustrated when feeding
• 6m+ Fast Flow: As baby moves on to solids and takes longer to feed from a medium flow teat, fast flow will keep up with their growing appetite

Why are the teats flattened?
When breastfeeding, baby flattens mum’s nipple in their mouth - that’s why our breast like teats are flattened, helping to reduce bottle confusion and make bottle feeding as comfortable and natural as possible.
What is the Flexzone™?
The FlexZone™ is the flexible part around the bottle teat that allows it to move and flex just like mum’s breast does when feeding.
Are they anti-colic?
Our triple anti-colic valves do the heavy lifting by reducing air intake during feeds and preventing colic symptoms. Colic is a common issue in young babies and is often caused by digestive or feeding problems, which are linked to swallowing air while feeding. This can lead to discomfort and make feeding and settling baby stressful for everyone.
Keeping a consistent feeding routine, ensuring your baby is in a comfortable position while feeding, and using a bottle designed to minimise air intake can help make feeding times more relaxed for everyone involved.
How will I know?
Healthcare professionals agree that the most common signs of colic include intense bouts of crying, when your baby seems otherwise healthy. Other indicators can include clenching their fists, drawing their knees up to their tummy, or appearing tense and agitated.
What flow do I need?
We offer a variety of teats in varying flow rates. Remember, every baby is different and this is just a guide:
• 0m+ Newborn Flow: Perfect for newborns, offering a slow, gentle start.
• 1m+ Slow Flow: Perfect for babies that are getting into the swing of feeding and newborns with a bigger appetite.
• 3m+ Medium Flow: As baby grows, so does their appetite! Switch to medium if you notice they’re taking a long time to feed or are getting frustrated when feeding.
• 6m+ Fast Flow: As baby moves on to solids and takes longer to feed from a medium flow teat, fast flow will keep up with their growing appetite.

Use to clean grubby hands, messy faces, dirty bums and more. Spray directly on skin for antibacterial cleansing at home and on the go. Suitable for Vegans and Vegetarians.
What’s it made from?
There’s only 2 ingredients in our cleansing water – water and hypochlorous acid from electrolysed water. Hypochlorous acid is naturally produced in our bodies to fight infection and keep us safe. It doesn’t have any harmful chemicals, alcohol or fumes and is also frequently used in medical products such as eyedrops.
Is it safe?
Absolutely - the ingredients are perfectly safe for skin contact from birth, even on the most delicate skin. Aquaint has been dermatologically tested to ensure it’s gentle and hypoallergenic.
Is it just for baby?
While Aquaint was developed with our youngest customers in mind, we would never gatekeep the benefits of Aquaint. Believe us, we're big fans of a fresh spritz after hitting the gym, a quick facial cleanse after a commute, or a relaxing nighttime skincare routine. All ages, all faces, we've got you covered.

Do not dilute. Liberally spray onto skin. No need to wait, wipe or rinse. Safe to use on all skin types. Once opened, use within 3 months.

Gem Imports FAQs | Pound Shop Supplier
Below is a list of our most frequently asked questions. Here you can find information on ordering, delivery information and more.
If you don’t find the answer you’re looking for, you can contact us through the Contact Us section of our website.
Delivery - FAQ
Find out the answers to our most frequently asked delivery questions...
If you can’t find the answer to your query, contact customer service on 01226 395095 (Mon-Fri 8:30 am to 5 pm)
Q. What are your shipping costs?
A. Our delivery charges are based on pallet rates by our carrier, which are visible on the checkout page and on our delivery information page:
• UK Mainland - we offer free delivery on orders over £500 net.
• Scottish Highlands & Islands - shipping is calculated on the basket page.
• For Channel Islands orders - shipping is calculated on the basket page.
• Northern & Southern Ireland - we offer free delivery on orders over £2,000 net. For orders between £1,000 and £2,000, shipping is calculated on the basket page.
• Europe - rates for European deliveries are dependent on the size and weight of your order. Please contact us to obtain a quote before placing your order by calling 01226 395095 or by emailing customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk.
Q. How long before I receive my order?
A. Orders placed before 10 pm, Monday to Friday, will be dispatched within two working days. Orders placed on a weekend will be dispatched the following Tuesday.
Please note that some delays may occur during Bank Holidays.
• On the day that we dispatch your order, we will email you with your invoice. Your order will arrive within the following timescales:
• Mainland UK within 3-5 working days
• Scottish Highlands, Northern Ireland, Channel Islands and Offshore Islands within 3-5 working days
• Europe within 10 - 14 working days
• Under exceptional circumstances, we can allow for a named day delivery; however, this incurs a surcharge.
Delivery times are not binding
Q. What are your normal delivery slots?
A. Our courier usually delivers between 8 am and 6 pm, Monday to Friday. On rare occasions, some couriers may deliver outside of this time frame. Unfortunately, we are unable to accept requests for specific times or days.
All orders are dispatched on pallets, which are shrink-wrapped and fully covered. Whilst every effort is made to deliver orders in immaculate condition, occasionally damage can occur in transit. If you notice any visible signs of damage to the exterior pallets or cartons, please contact customer service on 01226 395095 or email customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk. Please do not accept the delivery if you suspect significant damage has been caused.
All goods are delivered on trucks equipped with rear tail lifts; therefore, please ensure your desired delivery address has sufficient access for the driver to safely and legally stop to unload the delivery. The driver is not responsible for decanting pallets; therefore, you will need to use your own personal equipment where possible to accept and take goods into your premises. Deliveries must be signed for by an adult aged 18 or over.
Please ensure that all details, including your delivery address, are correct, as we cannot be held accountable for any delivery errors caused by incorrect information you have provided.
Q. Do you charge VAT on European orders?
A. We will not charge VAT on European orders if we are shipping your order directly to you in an EU country. You must also provide us with a valid EU VAT-registered number. If we are shipping your order to a UK freight forwarder of your choice, or you have arranged for your order to be collected from our premises, we will charge VAT accordingly. Once your order has been shipped from the UK and you provide us with a valid export document that includes an EU VAT-registered number, we will refund the VAT we charged you.
Q. Can I ask for a Saturday or named day delivery?
A. Your order can be upgraded to be delivered on a named day or on a Saturday; however, this will incur a delivery surcharge.
Q. Do you ship internationally (outside the EU)?
A. We can deliver your order to any UK freight forwarder, who will ship your order to any worldwide destination. However, you would need to arrange your own freight forwarder and pay their costs. You will also be required to complete all necessary export documentation.
Opening an account FAQ's
Do you have queries about opening an account with Gem Imports?
See our most frequently asked questions below... Call 01226 395095 or register for a FREE account here.
Q. Do I have to be a company owner or run a business to buy from you?
A. No, anyone can buy from our product range, but we do have a minimum order value of £500 excluding VAT.
Q. Do you have a minimum order?
A. Yes, we do. The minimum order on www.gemimports.co.uk is £500 net (before VAT or delivery charges). You can order as many different products as you want, but each product is sold by the carton, not individually.
Q. Can I place an order for less than your minimum order?
A. Unfortunately, not. Our warehouse and logistics systems are designed to process large orders; therefore, all orders are shipped on pallets rather than in individual cartons.
Q. Some of your products have assorted colours, can I choose the colour of products that I buy?
A. No. If a product has assorted colours, styles or designs, you would purchase a mixed carton. We cannot split cartons.
Q. How do I make payment?
A. We accept all credit and debit cards, and there are no additional fees when paying by credit card. You can also use PayPal or a bank transfer (BACS). If paying by BACS, we can only dispatch your order once the funds have cleared in our account. This usually takes 5-7 working days. Please note that we require bank transfer payments to be made within 48 hours of receipt of a pro-forma invoice. Any delay in making your payment may result in the cancellation of your order, and we may charge an administration fee.
Q. Do you offer credit accounts?
A. At any time, you can complete a Gem Imports Credit Application Form. This can be downloaded from your 'My Account Section' of the website. A member of our sales team will review this, and you will be notified of the outcome. Please be aware that to process your application, we will perform a soft credit check.
Q. Do you have discount codes or special offers?
A. We are the UK's cheapest online wholesaler, and we work hard to offer you the lowest possible price. All wholesale prices on our website are already discounted.
Ordering Process FAQ'S
Ordering with Gem Imports is simple,
1. Register for a FREE account Here
2. View and browse our unrivalled wholesale prices.
3. Checkout and receive your delivery within 3-5 working days.
Still need some questions answered? See our most frequently asked questions below.
Q. How does Pre-Order work?
For certain departments and product ranges, we have introduced the ability to secure your stock in advance of delivery into our warehouse.
We understand that many of you want to ensure access to products that are not yet in our warehouse, and this is the way to do it.
Whilst you've always been able to do this through our sales team, you can now do it yourself on this website.
How does it work?
You can Pre-order products that have the ‘Pre-Order’ badge displayed on them, which looks like this..
Pre-order products can only be ordered along with products from the same range. For example, if you want to order your standard replenishment stock for immediate delivery and pre-order from our Christmas range, you will need to place two separate orders. Both orders must meet a net order value of £500.
You cannot mix pre-ordered products with products from other ranges. The £500 minimum order value applies to pre-orders as usual.
Why do I have to order pre-order products separately?
To keep things simple and avoid mixing in-stock items with pre-orders, we ask that pre-order products be purchased only with other items from the same range. This helps us manage orders smoothly and keep prices competitive for you.
What is Pre-order Pay Later?
We understand that although you might want to secure your stock a long time in advance of the season, you might not always want to pay for it at the time of ordering.
For selected Pre-Order ranges, we offer "Pre-order Pay Later" - place your Pre-Order now, and we'll only ask for payment closer to the shipping date.
How do I create a Pre-order?
Navigate to the range of products you are interested in Pre-ordering, and look for the Pre-order badge. You can add as many Pre-order products as you wish to your basket, but they must:
All be from the same product range (e.g. all Halloween).
Have a total basket value of £500 minimum (i.e. our minimum order value of £500 applies to pre-orders too)
Once you have finalised your basket, go to checkout and 1. Either pay as usual, or 2. select "PAY ON ACCOUNT" - Selecting this will secure your order without any payment needed until closer to the season.
Your order will be sent once all items are in stock.
I need help with Pre-ordering.
Please contact our Customer Service team, and we'll be happy to help.
Q. Can I add additional products once I have checked out?
A. For us to offer a fast and professional service, once an order has been placed, it is immediately picked up by our warehouse. Any request to add products that we can meet may delay processing your order and may incur an administration charge. Please call us on 01226 395095 or email customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk quoting your name and order number to discuss this request.
Q. I have changed my mind, can I cancel my order?
A. Once we receive an order, it is processed immediately by our warehouse team. We regret that we can only cancel or amend orders under extreme circumstances. Please call us on 01226 395095 or email customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk quoting your name and order number to request this cancellation. We will do our very best to accommodate your request. If your order has been picked, your request may incur a cancellation charge. Unfortunately, we cannot cancel your order if it has already been shipped.
Q. There is a few pence difference between my invoice and my original order?
A. This is a standard industry occurrence and should not cause any problems when you are processing your company accounts and VAT returns. The difference is due to an anomaly in accounting systems where decimal places are rounded up when calculating VAT. Our website calculates VAT at the carton level rather than an accounting system that rounds VAT up from individual units.
Q. If I buy in bulk, can I receive a further discount?
A. We import all of our products in large quantities so that we can offer them at a discount price. If you want to purchase products in vast quantities, you may be eligible to use our direct import service, whereby we import your products directly from the Far East. The minimum order is a 20ft container. Please contact our customer service team by calling 01226 395095 or emailing customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk to discuss.
Q. Do you have any sales reps?
A. Yes, call 01226 395095 or email customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk to arrange a visit from one of our sales managers. We also have a showroom in South Yorkshire where you can view our products and receive advice.
Q. Can I use your website content on my own website?
A. You are permitted to save our product photography from our website by simply right-clicking on the image and selecting 'Save image as'. However, you cannot use our product descriptions. This is because search engines penalise websites that use the same content. Using our product descriptions will damage your search engine optimisation.
Q. Do you have a drop shipping service?
A. We do not ship units directly to end customers. We can deliver to any address in the UK, but you must meet our minimum order delivery requirement of £500 net.
If none of the above has answered your question, please do not hesitate to contact us by completing our Online Form, emailing customerservice@gem-imports.co.uk, or calling us on 01226 395090. A member of our team will respond as soon as possible.  Thank you.

Contains hydrogen peroxide, phenylenediamines (toluenediamines) and resorcinol. Do not use to dye eyelashes or eyebrows. Rinse hair well after application. L4@P0-1: ANIMAL WELFARE POLICYLatest Version Date June 2020 Doc Ref Animal Welfare Policy
L5@P1: Version Number 2.0 Page 2 of 5
L6@P1: Public Copy
L7@P1: BACKGROUND
L8@P1: Marks and Spencer are committed to using responsibly sourced raw materials including the
L9@P1: use of products derived from animals. This policy forms part of our commitment to uphold
L10@P1: the M&S animal welfare principles for all animal derived products we source.
L11@P1: SCOPE
L12@P1: This policy covers products sold in all Clothing, Home and Beauty areas that contain any
L13@P1: animal derived raw materials. The scope includes all main fabrics/textiles, trims,
L14@P1: componentry packaging, chemicals, pigments and dyestuffs.
L15@P1: This policy is intended to complement the additional specific sourcing policies for
L16@P1: Cashmere, Wool, Leather and Feather and Down.
L17@P1: RATONALE AND OBJECTIVES
L18@P1: • To ensure Marks & Spencer meets its long-standing commitment to improve animal
L19@P1: welfare in its supply chains and ensure all animal derived materials are sourced from
L20@P1: farms with good animal welfare practices. Marks & Spencer are committed to
L21@P1: improving animal welfare across our global supply chains and we are working to
L22@P1: source all animal-derived materials from farms with good animal welfare practices
L23@P1: • To lay out a set of uniform principles and guidelines around the sourcing of animal
L24@P1: derived raw materials
L25@P1: • To also ensure that appropriate due diligence is undertaken with regards to the
L26@P1: sourcing of products in relation to animal welfare
L27@P1: M&S MANDATORY PRINCIPLES FOR SOURCING
L28@P1: Marks and Spencer are committed to protecting any endangered or vulnerable species and
L29@P1: to the prevention of cruelty. Through our supply chains we seek to promote, encourage and
L30@P1: foster higher animal welfare standards using codes, recommendations and audited supply
L31@P1: chains. We will continuously review our supply chains and where there are practices that
L32@P1: are of concern, we will take a considered course of action.
L33@P1: No animal will be slaughtered specifically for the manufacture or sourcing of M&S products.
L34@P1: PROHIBITED SOURCES
L35@P1: The following materials do not comply with our business principles for animal welfare and
L36@P1: therefore must not be used in any of our non-food products:
L37@P1: • Any material from any endangered species, defined as those which appear on the
L38@P1-2: Convention on International Trade in Endangered Species (CITES) (see www.cites.org/ Latest Version Date June 2020 Doc Ref Animal Welfare Policy
L39@P2: Version Number 2.0 Page 3 of 5
L40@P2: Public Copy
L41@P2: for list of species) or the IUCN red list as Critically Endangered,
L42@P2: Endangered or Vulnerable (www.redlist.org/).
L43@P2: • No animal must be slaughtered specifically to produce any non- food M&S products.
L44@P2: • Fur: this includes farmed fur (e.g. fox, sable, mink, chinchilla, rabbit)
L45@P2: • Angora Rabbit fibre
L46@P2: • Alpaca fibre
L47@P2: • Astrakhan (Karakul) or any other leather/skin products which are the product of
L48@P2: unnatural abortions
L49@P2: • Any material obtained from live skinning (e.g. reptiles) or live boiling
L50@P2: • Any cow hides sourced from India
L51@P2: • Any animal derived bone or horn
L52@P2: • Any down or feathers from exotic birds, including but not limited to ostrich
L53@P2: • Any coral
L54@P2: RESTRICTED SOURCES
L55@P2: The following materials are currently accepted provided minimum requirements are met:
L56@P2: • Leather must be sourced in compliance with our Responsible Leather Sourcing Policy
L57@P2: • Animal Fibres (e.g. wool, cashmere) must be sourced in compliance with our Responsible
L58@P2: Wool Sourcing Policy and our Cashmere Code of Practice for animal welfare respectively.
L59@P2: All wool must be sourced from sheep that have not been mulesed
L60@P2: • Mohair must only be sourced through routes fully certified to the Textile Exchange
L61@P2: Responsible Mohair Standard (RMS)
L62@P2: • Feather and Down must not be obtained from the live plucking of birds or from birds used
L63@P2: in the production of Foie Gras. All Feather and Down must be sourced in compliance to
L64@P2: our Responsible Feather and Down Sourcing Policy
L65@P2: • All other animal derived materials must be sourced in accordance with this policy and
L66@P2: relevant details must be provided on an Animal derived material declaration form
L67@P2: • Any shell from vulnerable or endangered species must not be used (as defined by
L68@P2: CITES/IUCN red list)
L69@P2-3: • Only pearls form cultivated sources are allowed Latest Version Date June 2020 Doc Ref Animal Welfare Policy

L72@P3: THE FIVE FREEDOMS OF ANIMAL WELFARE
L73@P3: In developing minimum standards for sourcing any animal product Marks & Spencer
L74@P3: consider the internationally recognised “Five Freedoms” as a framework and for guidance. It
L75@P3: is important that the sourcing of any animal derived materials for M&S are underpinned by
L76@P3: these principles:
L77@P3: 1. Freedom from Hunger and Thirst – by ready access to fresh water and a diet to

L79@P3: 2. Freedom from Discomfort – by providing an appropriate environment including
L80@P3: shelter and a comfortable resting area
L81@P3: 3. Freedom from Pain, Injury and Disease – by prevention or rapid diagnosis and
L82@P3: treatment

L84@P3: facilities and company of the animal’s own kind

L99@P3: ownership.

Frequently Asked Questions
Frequently Asked Questions
ABOUT OUR PRODUCTS
What is the difference between a First and a Second?
All pottery is inspected before it leaves our factory. As all of our pieces are handmade, some items may contain small faults. We classify these items as “seconds”. When an item is classified as a second the fault may be in the finish, the decoration or the shape. The faults are not structural, so each piece still functions as intended and is usable. The fault will be marked with a black or red pen, but don’t worry this will easily wash off.
Please visit our Outlet section for our current range of seconds and discontinued items.
Can I personalise an item?
Visit the Personalised Section of our website to see our full range of personalised items and to place an order online.
All personalised orders are considered final at the point of order placement, please ensure that you take extra care when entering any names or messages into our website as we are unable to offer refunds or replacements.
All of our personalised pottery is decorated by hand, so you may see a slight variation between personalised pieces depending on the lettering and pattern that you have chosen.
Unfortunately, we are unable to consider requests for specific decorators and/or layouts.
How do your Pre-Order items work?
We will sometimes list items as Pre-Order to help us understand demand and provide the best experience for our customers. When you place a Pre-Order, payment will be taken immediately and your item will be delivered to you as soon as it is available. If you order other in-stock items at the same time, they will be delivered to you straight away.
We will show an expected Availability Date for the item on the website and also on your order confirmation email. This may change and we will update the website if so.
We may also show a Pre-Order Closing Date. You will not be able to place any orders after this date so order quickly!
Can I purchase Gift Vouchers online?
Please click here if you wish to purchase an Online Gift Voucher. Online Gift Vouchers can only be redeemed online at emmabridgewater.co.uk, or via our telephone ordering service.
Online Gift Vouchers will expire 1 year after purchase.
Do Emma Bridgewater products come with a guarantee?
Due to the fact our ware is made by hand including the decoration, variations will occur and we call that its charm.
We guarantee all our products for 2 years from the date of purchase, whether a self-purchase or a received as a gift. The guarantee does not cover normal wear and tear, commercial use, or misuse of the product.
If for any reason your product develops a fault during this 2 year period, then just contact us and we will replace it free of charge. You may be required to provide a photo of the faulty items, a proof of purchase or return the item to us (at our expense). If your original item is no longer available, then a like for like replacement will be offered. Please contact the original place of purchase for any items that you did not buy directly from us.
What is 'Crazing'?
Crazing is when very fine cracks or lines appear in the glaze on pottery.
I’ve noticed some crazing on my Emma Bridgewater product, what should I do?
Please contact our Customer Services team directly and give them the details. If the product is less than 5 years old, they will aim to replace the product for you free of charge with a similar product, or one of equivalent value if the original product is no longer in production.
In some instances, depending on the product and its age, they may also ask you to return your product (free of charge). This is so we can investigate the crazing to help us improve our manufacturing process in future.
To claim under the guarantee please e-mail customerservices@emmabridgewater.co.uk with the following details if possible:
Place and date of purchase.
A Receipt, the email address the order was placed with, or some form of proof of purchase if available.
Description of the fault and photos.
Don’t worry if you cannot locate your order number. If you can provide the email address for the order the item was placed with the customer service team will have a record of your order history.
If the Item was a gift, and if you can provide the email address the item was purchased with, then we can help.
Why has my product crazed?
Although we don’t always know the answer to this question, we have been investing in several areas of our factory recently to improve the consistent quality of all our pottery. Our Customer Services team may ask you to send photos or return your product so our quality team can carry out further investigation.
Sometimes crazing occurs in products that have not been fired correctly. Whilst this rarely happens, we continuously carry out internal maintenance and regular inspections of our kilns along with the testing of our clay to ensure we are improving how we make our pottery.
Is it safe to continue using my crazed pottery?
We recommend you contact our Customer Services team if your product is crazed and they will give you specific advice. We would love you to be using perfect Emma Bridgewater product so please do contact us and if the product is less than 5 years old we will aim to replace it for you.
Why can’t you guarantee Emma Bridgewater product won’t craze?
We constantly aim to improve the quality of our product, but unfortunately can’t always guarantee that our product won’t craze over time. We have made a number of specific improvements in the factory over recent months and have more plans for the year ahead. Much of this investment aims to improve the quality of our product and to reduce the possibility of product crazing.
I've broken the lid on my teapot. Can you replace it?
Unfortunately we no longer offer lids individually any more. This is because all of our pottery is made by hand, and the base and lid are made specifically to fit one another. Due to this we no longer make or retail bases and lids separately.
Can I replace a piece that has been broken?
We frequently introduce new designs, but this does means that we sometimes have to say goodbye to old favourites. We are unable to reproduce discontinued pieces, but do sometimes have some items available at our Factory Outlet. Please visit our Store Locator to find their contact details.
How should I care for my pottery item?
All of our pottery is dishwasher safe (this excludes the pottery which is decorated with silver or gold). When using a dishwasher, we suggest you use a lower temperature setting and liquid detergent to maintain the pristine appearance of the product.
What does 'Microwave Safe' mean?
To qualify as microwave safe, products must:
Not leach harmful or toxic chemicals or substances into food.
Not break, crack, shatter, or become damaged in some way when heated in the microwave oven.
Be cool enough to handle after 2 minutes in the microwave.
We recommend you don’t put Emma Bridgewater pottery in the microwave. Our pottery is not oven safe unless marked as cookware.
Can I use Emma Bridgewater products to make items to sell myself?
Emma Bridgewater is a brand with distinctive style and personality across home and lifestyle products.
Using our distinctive patterns together with practical design we produce lots of products, so it’s not only our pottery that is beautiful, useful and instantly recognised as Emma Bridgewater.
Our non-pottery products (excluding textiles and glass) are produced with the very best manufacturers, through licensing agreements. This means that our fabrics, wallpaper, bedding, stationery, and napkins are not manufactured in our own factory but are produced in factories we work with. These products are widely available to buy in the market.
There has been a recent trend for hand-crafted, home-made products and we have been increasingly asked if such products can be made with our gift-wrap, napkins, fabrics, tea towels and more.
We are hugely flattered that people want to make things using Emma Bridgewater products and whilst we cannot endorse any product, we are happy to allow it to happen.
Any customer is entitled to buy one of our many Emma Bridgewater products and use it to make a product to sell.
Any product made from Emma Bridgewater product can be marketed as an Emma Bridgewater product, but cannot feature, or be associated with, the Emma Bridgewater logo.
If you have any questions please contact Marketing@emmabridgewater.co.uk
Guidelines for Personalised Products
We love to help you celebrate special occasions and memories – these are our helpful hints to make sure your message can be written onto our handmade pottery.
When creating personalised text for your Emma Bridgewater item, please see our guidelines below. We reserve the right to cancel any order which we deem inappropriate and do not follow our guidelines.
We do not accept words or phrases which we consider to:
• infringe anyone else’s intellectual property rights, such as copyrighted material, brand names, or slogans
• break the law or encourage others to do so
• cause harm with false, misleading, offensive, threatening, or defamatory language
• cause unnecessary distress, annoyance, or embarrassment to anyone
• impersonate someone else or be misrepresentative
• be pornographic, indecent, or contain sexual references/promote sexually explicit content
• promote discrimination, hatred, or violence based on race, sex, religion, nationality, disability, sexual orientation, age, or other protected characteristics
• harass, insult, bully, or humiliate any individual or group
• contain political statements or positions that may be divisive, harmful, or offensive
• encourage or promote self-harm, suicide, or eating disorders/provide guidance on how to do so
• suggest that the content is endorsed by Emma Bridgewater Ltd or our partners, whether by name or implication
• damage the reputation of Emma Bridgewater Ltd or our partners
Why have you increased your prices?
From 22nd September 2025 there was a change to the price of Emma Bridgewater pottery, reflecting continuing increases in manufacturing costs such as raw materials, energy, and US import duties.
At Emma Bridgewater, we’re rooted in skilled craftsmanship and traditional hand-making techniques, with our factory in Stoke-on-Trent at the very heart of our business.
We employ more than 300 people, with thirty pairs of hands involved in making every piece of pottery. Our first priority is to make high quality pottery with care that our customers will treasure.

DELIVERY & RETURNS
Where is my order?
We aim to deliver all orders to mainland UK within 3-5 days. Orders for overseas delivery may take longer. Please see our Delivery Information for full details of all delivery timescales.
On despatch of your order you will receive an email containing a link that allows you to track its progress.
How can I return my order?
Faulty or Damaged Items
If any of the items in your order are faulty or damaged, then please contact us within 30 days of your order being delivered and we will send you a label that will allow you to return them to us free of charge for a replacement or refund.
Unwanted Items
We do not currently offer free of charge returns for unwanted items, but you can arrange a return via EVRi for £6. Please contact us if you would like to return an item.
For hygiene reasons, we are unable to accept returns for some items unless they are faulty. Please visit our Returns section for a full details of which items this applies to.
Returns Address:
Customer Services
Emma Bridgewater
50 Whittle Road
Meir Point
Stoke-on-Trent
ST3 7TU
How long will it take for my order to arrive?
UK Economy Delivery
Economy orders will be delivered within 5-7 working days. This service is not available for Personalised items.
UK Standard Delivery
We aim to deliver standard orders within 3-5 working days. Personalised and Non-Scripted items will take up to 2 weeks.
UK Next Day Delivery
Next Day orders placed by 6pm Monday to Friday will be delivered the next day. Orders placed after 6pm on Friday will be delivered the following Tuesday. Next Day delivery is not always available during Sale.
International Orders
We aim to deliver all international orders within 14 days.
Please see our Delivery Information page for full details of all delivery timescales.
What delivery options do you have?
In the UK, we offer No Rush, Standard, Next Day and Local Collection (via stores and lockers). You will be presented with all available options at checkout once you have entered your address details.
Please note that Next Day and Local Collection delivery options are not available for Personalised and Oversized items.
All international orders will be shipped on a standard rate with FedEx.
Can I specify a delivery time slot?
We do not currently offer customers the ability to specify a delivery time slot but do offer next day delivery for UK mainland orders. Please see our Delivery Information for full details.
What happens if I'm not in when you attempt delivery?
A signature may be required, if you are not in your order could be left in a safe location or with a neighbour. If these are not available your order will re-attempted for delivery the next working day. Please review your tracking detail for any updates.
Can I collect from my order from an Emma Bridgewater shop?
Currently we do not offer a deliver to our shops option.
Can I send my order to multiple addresses?
We don't offer the ability to select multiple delivery addresses in one order. A separate order will need to be placed for each delivery address.
What should I do if my order arrives damaged or with items missing?
If you are not happy with your order, then please contact us within 30 days of your order being delivered.
What should I do if I'm unhappy with my order?
If you are not happy with your order, then please contact us.
If some items in my order are delayed - will I receive my other items in the meantime?
With the exception of pre-ordered products, we will despatch all items in your order at the same time. This may result in a delay to the delivery of your overall order due to a delay with specific items.
ORDER HISTORY, AMENDS & ACCOUNT ACCESS
How do I activate my account?
If you are unable to activate your account from the link sent on the account activation email. Or you didn’t receive one, please try to activate your account by following the below steps.
1. Click on this link to set up you account again.
2. Ensure that you fill in the form using the same email address you had set up on our previous site.
3. Once the new account has been created and activated, it will link to your old account.
4. This will include your past delivery addresses, marketing preferences and whether you are a member of the Collector’s club.
5. If you get the message 'Email has already been taken' instead of setting up your account again, click here and follow the 'forgotten your password' link.
If you are still having any issues logging in or accessing your account please contact our Customer Services team on 01782 210565.
Can I cancel or amend my order?
Order Cancellation - Personalised Items:
All personalised orders are considered final at the point of order placement. As such, please ensure that you take extra care when entering any names or messages into our website as we are unable to offer refunds or replacements for personalised items.
Order Cancellation - Non-Personalised Items:
We are unable to cancel orders containing non-personalised items once the order has been confirmed.
Change of Delivery Address:
We are unable to change the delivery address for an order once the order has been confirmed. As such, please ensure that you take extra care when entering names and addresses.
Adding/Removing Items from an Order:
Unfortunately we are unable to add items to or remove items from an order once it has been placed.
Where can I view my previous orders?
Log in to My Account to view your order history.
OUR COLLECTORS CLUB
What is the Emma Bridgewater Collectors Club and why might I want to join?
As a member of our Collectors Club you have access to a host of Member only benefits. These include: invitations to exclusive events; the ability to purchase limited edition Collectors Only pieces and early entry to our Sale. You will also be able to access our online Members Page which contains exclusive information regarding new patterns and product launches.
How do I join?
Lifetime membership costs £10 and can be purchased by clicking here.
WHOLESALE QUERIES
Can I sell Emma Bridgewater products in my shop?
If you are interested in stocking Emma Bridgewater in your shop please contact our Wholesale Team on sales@emmabridgewater.co.uk.
COMPLAINTS
I have a complaint. What should I do?
We hope that you're pleased with any purchase you've made from Emma Bridgewater, and that you'll never have reason to complain - but if there's something you're not happy with, we'd like to help. Please Click Here for our Customer Services Team's contact details.
When contacting our customer services team for a quicker resolution there are a couple of things to remember to have ready.
Please include your order number, email address and attach any images to an email of damaged or faulty product.

product.name: La Drogheria Mediterranean Sea Salt Mill Adjustable Grinder
product.features: All natural
product.detailed_description: La Drogheria Mediterranean Sea Salt Mill Grinder 90g – Pure & Natural Flavour Experience the clean, natural taste of the Mediterranean with the La Drogheria Mediterranean Sea Salt Mill Grinder 90g. Harvested from sun-dried sea salt deposits, this high-quality salt enhances the flavour of any dish with its bright, balanced taste. The adjustable grinder allows you to customise the texture, from fine to coarse, making it perfect for everyday cooking and gourmet finishing touches. - Premium Mediterranean Sea Salt – Naturally rich in minerals for pure flavour. - Adjustable Grinder – Control the grind for precise seasoning. - Pure & Natural – No additives, just high-quality sea salt. - Versatile Use – Ideal for meats, vegetables, pasta, and finishing dishes. - Convenient & Easy to Use – A must-have for any kitchen. Enhance Every Dish with Mediterranean Sea Salt From simple home cooking to gourmet meals, the La Drogheria Mediterranean Sea Salt Mill brings out the natural taste of your ingredients with every twist. How to Adjust the Grind Size: - For a Coarse Grind – Pull the grinder up while twisting to release larger flakes. - For a Fine Grind – Push the grinder down while twisting for a finer seasoning. How to Use the Grinder: - Hold the grinder firmly over your dish. - Push up or down to set your preferred grind size. - Twist the top to grind fresh seasoning directly onto your food.
product.brand_marketing: La Drogheria – Italian Excellence in Herbs & Spices Founded in Florence in 1880, La Drogheria & Alimentari has been dedicated to selecting and crafting the finest herbs and spices for over a century. As Italy’s leading producer of premium seasonings, we source high-quality whole spices directly from their countries of origin, ensuring authenticity and rich flavour in every blend. Our signature adjustable grinders set us apart, allowing you to release the full aroma and taste of freshly ground spices with every twist. Designed for convenience and precision, they ensure optimal seasoning for any dish, from delicate infusions to bold, aromatic flavours. At our state-of-the-art facility near Florence, we combine tradition with innovation, using advanced technology and rigorous quality controls to uphold the highest standards. With a passion for flavour and a commitment to excellence, La Drogheria continues to bring authentic Italian craftsmanship to kitchens around the world. La Drogheria – Elevating Everyday Flavour with Italian Expertise.
